jobs.title: Bilingual Case Manager II
jobs.description:
Catholic Charities Housing Support Services “To provide individual and crisis intervention counseling and services to program clients in order to ensure opportunity for clients to maintain their housing. To implement and deliver all aspects of peer support and to assist program participants in achieving short\- and long\-term goals.”

The Case Manager will be responsible for core housing case management, benefits advocacy, support services for physical and mental health – acute/chronic, and problem solving. Provide assistance to people accessing other applicable housing opportunities. Assist clients in maintaining or increasing their housing stabilization.

Working to assess the Participants needs, by providing immediate services, personal goals, and services plans. This position will work with Participants around self\-sufficiency, and how to maintain independence and prevent homelessness. Through the program, clients may receive case management referrals to community support and counseling.

The Case Manager provides advocacy and referral services as needed to Participants, and where possible, assist with maintaining housing.

* Caseload portfolio assignment up to 35\-40 clients
* Provide comprehensive screening and assessment of clients and services needed.
* Develop person centered care plans: provide counseling, monitoring and care plan changes as necessary.
* Arrange for services to meet the client’s needs as documented in the care plan to address the immediate and long\-term needs of clients.
* Provide practical support, education and assistance to tenants in addressing immediate needs related to achieving stability and life management skills, with a minimum of monthly client contact.
* Coordinate with the Catholic Charities CYO programs and community agencies to ensure communication and quality service to the clients.
* Provide on\-going support including but not limited to the following: information and referral for services, client contact, and assist in meeting the goals of the client’s service plan.
* Comply with program policies and procedures to protect client and caregiver interests and facilitate the smooth operation of the program.
* Maintain accurate, current, and complete client files and complete all required data collection forms and reports. Maintain appropriate records for monthly reports.
* Data entry into CARES Systems and completion of monthly reports.
* Participate in staff meetings, client peer reviews, in\-services and other training as required.
* Coordinate contact with collaborative agencies as needed to identify any client issues that might result in an improved or destabilize a housing and to conduct an appropriate intervention as required
* Interface with other agencies and departments to ensure appropriate client compliance with Program requirements.
* Other duties as assigned
* Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Education \& Experience:**

* BA degree and one year of experience preferred or AA degree and three years related experience. (Equivalent education and experience demonstrating the ability to perform the job may be considered.)
* Two years experience providing client case management services with the housing insecure population and/or service programs preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:**

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Knowledge of San Francisco County social services networks.
* Sensitivity to and possess a knowledge of services for seniors and adults with disabilities, homelessness/unstable housing, substance use disorders, and associated Healthcare \[physical and mental health – acute/chronic] issues.
* Certified or familiarity with HCV/Housing Quality Standards.
* Interacting with persons from various social, cultural, economic, and educational backgrounds for the purpose of stabilizing or improving housing situations.
* Bilingual in Spanish, Tagalog, Mandarin/Chinese, or other language preferred.
* Functional knowledge of Microsoft Office Products.
* Ability to perform duties with minimum supervision.
* Ability to communicate clearly in both verbal and written forms.
* Promote a positive professional and organizational image in the community.
* Sensitivity to seniors and people with disabilities and their needs.
* Knowledge of mandatory reporting requirements for people working with ageing adults.
* Sensitivity in handling complex/confidential information.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Ability to work as a member of a team.
* Valid CA Driver’s License and personal car preferred
* Demonstrates the necessary attitudes, knowledge and skills to deliver culturally competent services and work effectively in cross\-cultural situations.

**Prerequisites Required Prior to the First Day of Employment:**

Fingerprints: **Required**

Negative Tuberculosis Test: **Required**

First Aid

Certificate: **Required**

Proof of Vaccination: **Required**

jobs.description:
**What the Role Is**



As the CS Enablement Program Manager, you'll be the business owner of the systems that make both our human agents and AI agents effective, starting with the quality and integrity of the knowledge they rely on. As a highly autonomous, high\-judgment IC, you'll build and continuously improve the knowledge base, SOPs, training, and AI\-powered workflows that underpin Customer Support across Babylist and Babylist Health. You'll bring deep operational rigor and a strong understanding of how AI is changing customer support—using the technology in your own work while designing systems that make it more effective across the organization. This is a greenfield opportunity to build the CS Enablement function at a tech\-first consumer company: identifying where knowledge, policies, and workflows break down, and partnering across CS, BizOps Tech, Product, and Analytics to build a support system that gets smarter and more reliable as we scale.


**Who You Are**


* **Deep expertise in Support Operations, Enablement, or Knowledge Management**: you've owned documentation, workflows, and operational strategy in high\-volume environments.
* **Can build and manage a knowledge base from scratch** (Zendesk, Gladly, Help Scout, Notion, Guru, or similar), organizing content and maintaining accuracy at scale so both humans and AI systems can use it effectively.
* **Can design for a hybrid AI\-agent and human\-agent support organization**: structuring content for AI consumption, writing effective prompts, evaluating output quality, and calling the line between what's automated and what stays human\-owned.
* **Can write clear, usable SOPs** for complex, multi\-step, or edge\-case scenarios, and know when to automate them instead.
* **Can build and deliver training that actually changes how people work**: onboarding, process rollouts, tool adoption, AI workflow enablement.
* **Strong analytical instincts**: you can read support data (ticket trends, contact drivers, resolution times) and turn it into decisions about what to fix, automate, or rebuild.
* **Comfortable being the first person to do this job.** This space doesn't have an established playbook in customer support yet, you'll be creating it.
* **Effective cross\-functional partner** who can work with BizOps, Product, Analytics, and engineering\-adjacent teams to drive real change, not just executing within your own lane.
* **Demonstrated track record of using AI to do your own work better**. At Babylist every team uses AI daily. You're already using it daily to move faster and improve your output, and have real opinions about when it works and when it doesn't.


**How You Will Make An Impact**


* Build the CS Enablement program from the ground up: create the systems that keep agents (human and AI) current on knowledge base, training, and copilot content as product changes accelerate.
* Move support operations from AI\-assisted to AI\-native: rebuild workflows, documentation, and training so AI is the default operating model.
* Build and maintain the knowledge base that serves as the source of truth for both AI systems and human agents, structured for AI consumption and kept accurate as products and policies evolve.
* Close existing content gaps and continuously identify how to reduce unnecessary escalations and drive meaningful improvement in chatbot coverage and resolution rate.
* Lead the implementation of an AI copilot and bring usage to 90%\+ of agent interactions by making the copilot genuinely useful (better source material, better prompt design).
* Build agent confidence through scalable training that teaches people when to trust AI, when to override it, and how to give feedback that improves it.
* Create SOPs for complex scenarios so cases get handled consistently, audit and streamline fragmented workflows, and design new processes with AI built in from the start.
* Partner with the CS Analyst to identify top contact drivers and documentation gaps, then act on them.
* Establish feedback loops with frontline agents so the system keeps improving instead of just when someone notices a problem.


**Why This Role**


* **You'd be defining a role that doesn't have a template yet.** "AI\-native CS enablement" isn't an established discipline in customer support. You won't be applying someone else's playbook, you'll be writing it.
* **The foundation is still forming, and that's the opportunity.** Most of the knowledge base, SOPs, and AI workflows don't exist yet, so the systems you build become how the org operates for years.
* **You'll have real influence on the roadmap, not just execution against it.** You're setting the agenda with BizOps Tech, Product, and Analytics on what gets fixed, automated, and rebuilt next.
* **Your success is directly visible in the numbers that matter to the business**: chatbot deflection, copilot adoption, CSAT. This isn't a support role in the background, it's core to how CS scales.


**About Compensation**



We use a market\-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:


**$140,000 to $170,000**



Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.


**Who We Are**



Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go\-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI\-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025\. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.

jobs.description:
**Extraordinary Careers. Endless Possibilities.**

**With the nation’s largest home infusion provider, there is no limit to the growth of your career.**


 Option Care Health, Inc. is the largest independent home and alternate site infusion services provider in the United States. With over 8,000 team members including 5,000 clinicians, we work compassionately to elevate standards of care for patients with acute and chronic conditions in all 50 states. Through our clinical leadership, expertise and national scale, Option Care Health is re\-imagining the infusion care experience for patients, customers and team members.


Join a company that is taking action to develop an inclusive, respectful, engaging and rewarding culture for all team members. At Option Care Health your voice is heard, your work is valued, and you’re empowered to grow. Cultivating a team with a variety of talents, backgrounds and perspectives makes us stronger, innovative, and more impactful. Our organization requires extraordinary people to provide extraordinary care, so we are investing in a culture that attracts, hires and retains the best and brightest talent in healthcare.

**Job Description Summary:**


Job Summary  

The Sterile Compounding Quality Manager will assist in supporting and maintaining cleanroom quality standards and sterile compounding processes to meet or exceed regulatory, accreditation, and quality requirements for all cleanrooms nationally. Serves as the primary quality resource for an assigned operating area, providing support to other areas as needed including after\-hours and weekend support during urgent quality events.
  

Responsible for monitoring, trending, and analyzing quality metrics, identifying risks, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Evaluates and recommends process improvements to enhance the quality, consistency, compliance, and safety of compounded sterile preparations (CSPs).
  

Collaborates with appropriate stakeholders to ensure organization adherence to current regulations, industry standards, and best practices for sterile compounding. Ability to independently with a high degree of autonomy, demonstrating sound judgement, initiative, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities while partnering with leadership and Cleanroom Help team to achieve quality, clinical and regulatory goals.**Job Description:**

* Provides support to the field as a subject matter expert regarding all cleanroom quality related questions and provides assistance during urgent cleanroom quality incidents. Includes appropriate leadership to ensure field support and assisting in quality clinical decisions based on Option Care Health policy.
* Assist in the maintenance and review of various cleanroom quality systems and tools. Provide reporting and executive summaries routinely and as directed.
* Works closely with cleanroom facilities team, and local leadership to ensure certifications are scheduled appropriately, reports are reviewed, microbial monitoring maps are current, accurate, and aligned with regulatory and operational requirements
* Review key performance indicators and quality systems/tools for trends and assist in the development of proactive and preventative initiatives to ensure quality for sterile compounding practices.
* Provides standard and ad\-hoc reports on quality improvement activities and adherence to quality metrics as requested. Assists in providing pharmacy metrics and various reports using relevant data sources.
* Leads root cause investigations and identifies systemic risks and contributing factors. Develops, coordinates, and monitors corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans with management and key stakeholders to ensure effective resolutions and continuous improvement
* Performs quality visits to conduct assessments and provide training regarding cleanroom quality and to assess cleanroom conditions. Communicates findings and action plans to appropriate corporate and/or field management personnel, legal and accreditation personnel as needed.
* Supports new cleanroom construction and remodel initiatives by providing quality and clinical guidance. Collaborates with stakeholders to develop and implement appropriate procedures, workflows, and controls to ensure compliant and effective cleanroom processes.
* In conjunction with management builds and maintains relationships with vendors. Provides support when intervention is required with vendors to support field cleanroom quality.
* Assist in the development of action plans for improvement based on Board of Pharmacy or other agency inspections, accreditation findings or internal quality indicators, recommendation and guidelines.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of policies, procedures, and training materials pertaining to sterile compounding and cleanroom quality based on Option Care Health standards and Federal and State regulations.
* Partner with Clinical Education on creating training materials and tools for orientations and training programs as it relates to sterile compounding, clean room maintenance, and regulatory compliance.
* Responsible for building and maintaining relationships with team members across Option Care

jobs.title: Assistant Bakery Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT INSOMNIA:**



Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then\-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery \+ delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet\-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!

  


Insomnia Cookies is actively hiring for a full\-time hourly Store Manager in Training (MIT) at our Dallas \- Victory Park store and we are seeking hospitality focused individuals looking to join our industry leading, rapidly growing, nationally recognized company!

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



At Insomnia Cookies, warm is more than how we serve our cookies—it’s how we show up for our guests, our teams, and each other.



As an Assistant Bakery Operations Manager (ABOM), you’ll help bring that to life every day by working side\-by\-side with your Bakery Operations Manager to build an energized, well\-trained team, create unforgettable guest experiences, and keep the bakery running at its best. You’ll coach and develop people, jump in wherever you’re needed, and take real ownership of the details that make a great bakery great—from staffing and inventory to quality, cleanliness, and execution. And when the BOM isn’t there, you’ll be ready to step up and lead.



This role is built for someone who wants more than an assistant manager job: it’s an opportunity to learn the business, grow as a leader, and develop the skills and confidence to one day run an Insomnia bakery of your own.


**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**



As a key member of the bakery leadership team, you will:


* Partner with your BOM to lead day\-to\-day bakery operations and deliver an exceptional guest experience.
* Lead the bakery independently when the BOM is away, keeping the team focused and operations running smoothly.
* Coach, motivate, and develop Shift Leaders and Cookie Crew members through real\-time feedback, recognition, and support.
* Support recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training to build a strong, fully staffed team.
* Help create schedules and manage labor to meet the needs of the bakery and the business.
* Support ordering, inventory management, product rotation, and shrink control.
* Maintain high standards for product quality, food safety, cleanliness, speed of service, and overall bakery execution.
* Complete required operational and administrative tasks accurately and on time.
* Identify opportunities to improve bakery performance and partner with your BOM and Area leadership to put solutions into action.
* Help create a culture where team members know what’s expected, feel supported, and are accountable for delivering their best.
* Jump in wherever needed—from serving guests and baking cookies to supporting the team during our busiest hours.


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**


* 1\+ year of leadership experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality, or another customer\-focused environment.
* Experience coaching, motivating, and developing hourly team members.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* A hands\-on leadership style and willingness to jump into any bakery role when needed.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple operational priorities.
* Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences and building great teams.
* Must be 18 years of age or older.
* Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.


**Physical Requirements**



This position regularly requires the ability to:


* Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
* Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
* Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
* Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
* Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point\-of\-sale system.
* Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
* Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
* Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
* Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast\-paced environment.


**Work Environment**



This position works in a fast\-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late\-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.


**Schedule Expectations**

jobs.title: Assistant Critical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY:**


STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award\-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost\-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience.


STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK.

**THE POSITION:**


STACK is looking for an Assistant Critical Operations Manager (ACOM) to support a local data center campus. As a leader in STACK’s Critical Operations team, the ACOM must possess an expert level of knowledge and will be responsible for assisting the Critical Operations Manager in maintaining the mechanical, electrical, fire life safety, base building, and other various internal data center systems. The ACOM will also be focused on the implementation of programs related to Safety, Team, Availability, Communication, and Knowledge. The Assistant Critical Operations Manager will report to the Critical Operations Manager.


The ACOM is responsible for the implementation of the Data Center Operations Program at their site and is responsible for employee training and ensuring all staff is adequately qualified to perform their duties. Holding regular team meetings and individual 1:1 sessions is required. The ACOM will assist the Critical Operations Manager in developing and maintaining CAPEX and OPEX budgets at the site level. They will also be responsible for project execution and management including developing scopes, obtaining proposals, creating purchase requisitions, and ensuring invoices are routed properly.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Lead and implement a standardized culture of always working safely across all STACK data centers.
* Serve as a datacenter subject matter expert for electrical, mechanical, fire life safety, and other data center systems.
* Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions within the facility.
* Implement site\-level efficiency projects and maintain overall site design PUE.
* Ensure STACK preventative and predictive maintenance program is executed.
* Train and mentor junior staff.
* Manage vendor relationships and service contracts.
* Assist in managing vendor procurement and billing processes.
* Support site budgeting and forecasting for both CapEx and OpEx.
* Create highly detailed technical procedures for maintenance events, emergency situations, and standard site evolutions.
* Perform expert technical review of procedures, company standards, and policies.
* Manage site audits, both internal and external, ensuring adherence to compliance standards.
* Manage systems to avoid unplanned, customer\-impacting outages.
* Manage the data floor and back\-of\-house mechanical loading capacity to ensure cooling system efficiency.
* Navigate and utilize CMS, EPMS, and BMS systems.
* Provide day\-to\-day exceptional customer service and support.
* Be available on\-call as required to respond to emergency situations at the data center.
* Perform other duties as required by STACK. Job duties, roles, and responsibilities are subject to change over time.

**THE DETAILS:**

* **Location: San Jose, CA**
* **Travel:** None or less than 5%
* **Benefits:** Healthcare, Dental Care, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Paid Leave Programs
* Must be eligible to work in the United States
* Must pass comprehensive background and drug screening

**MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum of 4–5 years' experience in a data center or other related mission critical operations role
* Knowledge of data center (hyperscale, enterprise, and colocation) and telecommunications industries
* Experience working with Microsoft Office applications and database software
* 3–5 years' experience managing facility preventative maintenance programs
* 3–5 years' experience in vendor and project management
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and perform well in stressful situations
* Expert understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., UPS, Transformers, PDUs, RPPs, Chillers, CRAH, CRAC, STS, ATS, Pre\-action systems)
* Expert knowledge of NFPA70e, NFPA72, NFPA25, and fire life safety compliance standards
* Experience in data center trending and analysis with ability to learn PC\-based monitoring systems
* Proficiency in data center commissioning standards
* Ability to perform physical tasks including standing, walking, climbing, and lifting up to 25 pounds
* Willingness to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, and on\-call support
* Comfortable working in a high\-stress, fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities

**Compensation Range:**

$73\.00 \- $76\.50**THIS MIGHT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF:**

* You are a strong communicator, you are persuasive and clear, blending analytics with experience in decision\-making.
* You do not get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple priorities while balancing urgent requests with shifting timelines and deliverables.
* You are a team builder. You take the time to understand and develop the strengths of your resources while formulating long\-term plans for the growth and success of the team.
* You are naturally curious and driven toward continual improvement. While you celebrate your successes, you take time to review and analyze campaigns for future learning.

**WHY STACK?**

* We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, flexible spending accounts – even a cell phone subsidy.
* We foster a culture of appreciation, including peer\-to\-peer recognition and rewards programs.

jobs.description:
**Operations Manager**


Rental Operations\- Hayward, CA


**About Med One Group:**


Med One Group, a leader in the medical equipment rental and finance industry for over 25 years, is seeking a self\-motivated Operations Manager to lead our distribution warehouse in Hayward, CA. This is a full\-time, salaried position with a starting base salary of $80,000\-$95,000, depending on experience.


In this role, you will oversee day\-to\-day warehouse operations while partnering closely with the Sales team to ensure exceptional customer service and operational excellence. The Operations Manager provides leadership, direction, and development to a team responsible for medical equipment processing, delivery coordination, scheduling, inventory management, and customer service.


**Essential Functions:**


* Thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Establish clear, measurable goals aligned with organizational objectives, ensuring strong alignment between people, processes, and strategy to drive consistent execution.
* Set high performance standards, hold teams accountable, and ensure full compliance with all policies and procedures.
* Lead by example by demonstrating a positive, committed approach to the business, colleagues, cross\-functional partners, direct reports, and clients.
* Collaborate with Sales and leadership to deliver customer\-focused, win\-win solutions.
* Build and strengthen customer relationships in close partnership with the Sales team.
* Oversee facility operations, including warehouse and office organization, cleanliness, supply inventory, coordination with home office IT, business licenses, and relationships with local property management.
* Apply strong business and financial acumen by managing contracts and overseeing Profit \& Loss (P\&L) statements and budgets to support account profitability.
* Drive continuous improvement across processes, products, and services while embracing innovation, change, and adaptability.
* Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and emergency off\-hours as business needs require.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation and respond to after\-hours calls as needed to support staff and operations.


**Job Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in warehouse operations, operations management, or a supervisory role.
* 3 to 5 years of leadership experience with a demonstrated ability to motivate teams, work independently, and take initiative. Experience in the medical equipment rental industry is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to build relationships and deliver excellent customer service.
* Proficiency with PC\-based applications, excellent organizational skills, and strong attention to detail.


**Additional Information:**


Med One offers a great work environment with a team of dedicated coworkers who take pride in what they do. We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as a Health Savings Account partially funded by Med One. Additional benefits include life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) plan through Vanguard, which employees are eligible to contribute to beginning on the first of the month following 30 days of employment. After one year of service, Med One matches 401(k) contributions up to 5%. We also offer paid time off, holiday pay, and a quarterly performance\-based bonus.


If you're a motivated leader who thrives in a collaborative, customer\-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**  

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.


The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short\-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.


Essential Functions:


1\. Management


Lead others and work effectively with store crews


Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew


Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner


Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement


2\. Customer Service


Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints


Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**
Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.


Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill


Ability to work a full\-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise  



  

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**
High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**


40**Time Type**


Full time**Pay Range**


The typical pay range for this role is:


$23\.65 \- $37\.65
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

  

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**


We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.  

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About** **Nooks.ai****:**
===========================


Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from *account strategy* to *prospect research* and *outreach*. Building 0 1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.


Today, over 1,500 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We’ve raised $70M\+ from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, which made its first sales\-tech investment in over a decade with us. Since then, we’ve tripled ARR each year for 3 years running and grown a high\-caliber team turning the art of sales into a scalable science.

**Recruiting Operations Manager**
=================================


Nook's is looking for a Recruiting Operations Manager to help build the systems, programs, and infrastructure that enable our recruiting organization to scale.


This is a highly cross\-functional, high\-ownership role for someone who loves making things better. You’ll sit at the intersection of Recruiting, People, Marketing, and the broader business — using data, technology, AI, and strong program management to improve how we attract, engage, and hire great talent.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

### **1\. Recruiting Operations**

* Own recruiting processes, reporting, analytics, and operating rhythms.
* Turn recruiting data into insights and actionable improvements.
* Manage and optimize our recruiting technology and vendor ecosystem, including security, billing, adoption, and training.
* Research and implement new tools and technologies that improve recruiter productivity and candidate experience.
* Drive the adoption of AI across recruiting, including evaluating new use cases and implementing Nooks Agent.
* Lead strategic research projects to help us make better, data\-driven recruiting decisions.
* Help develop and strengthen Nooks’ recruiting/employer brand and equip the team with consistent messaging and tools.
* Create leverage across the recruiting team through better systems, automation, processes, and team enablement.

### **2\. Talent Events \& Programs**


Own or support talent\-focused events and programs that strengthen Nooks’ brand and talent pipeline, including:

* Hackathons and technical events
* Conferences and industry events
* Nooks\-hosted events and dinners
* University and community events
* Creative new ways to get Nooks in front of exceptional talent


Partner cross\-functionally with Marketing, Recruiting, Engineering, and other teams to maximize the impact of these efforts.

### **3\. People Operations Partnership**


Partner with People Operations to ensure Recruiting and People processes scale together.


You’ll help:

* Implement and communicate new processes effectively.
* Identify when teams need training, documentation, or enablement.
* Improve cross\-functional workflows and eliminate operational friction.
* Support strategic People projects where your expertise can create leverage.

### **4\. University Programs**


Own and accelerate Nooks’ university recruiting strategy, with a particular focus on engineering talent.


You’ll build relationships with universities and technical communities, develop programs and events, measure results, and create a scalable pipeline of exceptional early\-career talent. You’ll partner with recruiters and hiring teams as needed while maintaining ownership of the overall program.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience in Recruiting Operations, Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting, Program Management, or a similar function.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Experience building processes or programs from the ground up.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI and emerging recruiting technology.
* Ability to manage systems, vendors, and multiple cross\-functional initiatives.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* A bias toward action and a willingness to operate in ambiguity.
* Someone who naturally looks for ways to create leverage, automate work, and make teams better.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


You’ll make Nooks’ recruiting organization **more scalable, data\-driven, technology\-enabled, and effective**.


You’ll help us spend less time on manual work, make better decisions with better data, get more value from our technology, build a stronger talent brand, create new talent pipelines, and give the recruiting team the leverage they need to focus on what they do best: **hiring exceptional people.**

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
------------------------------------------


Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

  

**About the team**
------------------


The Financial Partnerships Operations team supports smooth day\-to\-day collaboration with Airwallex’s banking partners across our global entities. We work closely with Financial Partnerships Managers, external financial institutions, and internal teams to improve processes, manage partner requirements, support new market expansion, and deliver high\-impact results across Airwallex’s products.

**What you'll do**
------------------


Reporting to the Director, Partnerships Strategy \& Operations, you will help support the day\-to\-day operations of the Financial Partnerships team and the continued growth of the organisation. You will play a significant role in our communications with external banking and financial partners, while helping ensure compliance with applicable regulations and maintaining the trust of our customers and stakeholders.


You will work with teams and partners across Airwallex’s product offerings, including Issuing, Online Payments, and Global Treasury \& Payment Network. This is an opportunity to join a growing team, improve how we operate at scale, and help shape the next phase of Airwallex’s global growth.


This role is based in New York, NY.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with the Financial Partnerships team as Airwallex expands into new markets and grows its network of banking, payment, and financial\-institution partners.
* Support the operational relationship with financial partners throughout their lifecycle with Airwallex, from onboarding and due diligence through integration, launch, steady state, and expansion.

* Develop continuous process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness. This may involve building new processes, streamlining existing workflows, leveraging technology, and implementing best practices.
* Own the triage of partner escalations, operational requests, and internal dependencies, ensuring issues are routed to the right teams and resolved in a timely manner against agreed KPIs.
* Coordinate regular due diligence sessions with Financial Crime Compliance and other relevant control functions, ensuring partner requirements are understood, documented, and completed on time.
* Partner with financial institutions on change management, ensuring new releases, scheme requirements, regulatory changes, and partner requests are executed properly by Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Generate and present reports to senior management and financial partners, providing clear visibility into partner health, implementation progress, operational risks, and areas for improvement.
* Contribute to scalable operating mechanisms, including partner scorecards, governance forums, QBRs, intake processes, playbooks, and performance dashboards.

**Who you are**
---------------


We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* At least 4 years of experience in financial services, fintech, payments, banking operations, strategy, business operations, partnerships, consulting, or a related field. Experience in a fast\-growing technology company or top\-tier financial institution is preferred.

* The ability to think critically and creatively while balancing growth, customer experience, operational effectiveness, and risk.

Operations Manager at Project Artaud

Reports to: Matrix structure including Executive Committee and Senior Bookkeeper  
Status: Part\-time, non\-exempt  
Compensation: $36\-45 per hour, commensurate with experience  
Benefits: Paid Sick leave, vacation/holiday pay, health insurance support, 401k plan

Hours \& Schedule: Estimated 30 hours per week across a 5\-day work week  
Location: On\-site at Project Artaud, San Francisco

ORGANIZATIONAL OVERVIEW

Project Artaud is a community\-governed artist live/work 501(c)(3\) membership organization in San Francisco dedicated to providing long\-term, low\-cost place for artists and cultural workers. The organization supports a diverse membership of resident artists and oversees a complex historic facility that requires consistent operational, administrative, and facilities coordination.

The Operations Manager plays a central role in ensuring that Project Artaud functions smoothly as both a community and an organization by overseeing daily operations, coordinating facilities\-related administration, supporting human resources and governance processes, and serving as a key point of contact for members, vendors, and partners.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Operations Manager is responsible for the coordination and administration of Project Artaud’s day\-to\-day organizational and facilities operations.

The Operations Manager works closely with the Facilities Administrator and Bookkeeper to ensure effective communication, compliance, documentation, and continuity of operations across the organization.

This position serves as a central hub for:

* Member communications and requests
* Facilities coordination and record\-keeping
* Organizational administration
* Human resources processes
* Office and systems management

* Maintain regular office hours and ensure consistent organizational presence

* Receive, distribute, and track mail, deliveries, notices, and official communications
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems for:
* Membership records
* Board and committee documents
* Volunteer tracking
* Administrative and legal files
* Policies and procedures
* Support preparation and distribution of agendas, notices, ballots, and meeting materials for Board and Committee meetings
* Maintain confidentiality of organizational and member information
* Provide logistical support for organizational meetings and events

* Emergency response coordination

* Emergency procedures
* Equipment and systems manuals

Member Services \& Communications

* Facilitate communication between members and appropriate committees or staff
* Coordinate access to office resources and systems
* Support internal communications such as newsletters, notices, and announcements
* Maintain bulletin boards, members\-only website, and shared information systems

* Track and route invoices and purchase orders for approval

* Support annual audits and required filings through record organization
* Ensure financial procedures are followed (without performing bookkeeping functions)
* Perform additional administrative duties as directed by the Executive Committee

* Maintain and manage software subscriptions and updates
* Identify opportunities to improve internal systems, workflows, and recordkeeping
* Support implementation of new operational tools and platforms

* Collaborative, service\-oriented mindset
* Passion for supporting artists and community\-based organizations

jobs.title: Silicon Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Etched**
================


Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Production Planning \& Scheduling**
-------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain end\-to\-end production schedules for silicon wafers, interposers, and test/assembly, supporting phases from engineering builds to mass production.
* Coordinate with foundries, OSATs (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test providers), and internal stakeholders to ensure production milestones and quality goals are met.
* Collaborate with test engineering teams to coordinate ATE test program development, bring\-up planning, and bench validation hardware readiness.
* Track and forecast capacity planning across all silicon manufacturing stages, including wafer fabrication, component procurement, assembly, and test.

**Supply Chain Coordination**
-----------------------------

* Manage the procurement, delivery, and scheduling of key silicon components (e.g., wafers, interposers, substrates) to ensure optimal time\-to\-market.
* Act as the operational lead between internal teams and suppliers, ensuring transparency and alignment across silicon, packaging, validation, and manufacturing.
* Prepare for mass production ramp by ensuring material readiness, test infrastructure availability, and logistic support to mitigate bottlenecks or delays.

**Forecasting \& Reporting**
----------------------------

* Build and maintain demand forecasts for silicon and related components, based on build plans, yield assumptions, validation schedules, and market dynamics.
* Share regular forecasts with supply chain partners and ensure proactive capacity allocation at foundries and OSATs.
* Generate and maintain detailed dashboards and reports to track schedule adherence, capacity utilization, inventory status, and delivery performance for executive and technical stakeholders.

**You may be a good fit if you have**
=====================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in supply chain management, production planning, or operations within the semiconductor industry.
* Deep understanding of the silicon lifecycle: tape\-out, fabrication, packaging, test, bring\-up, and validation
* Proven track record working with foundries (TSMC, Samsung, etc.) and OSATs (ASE, Amkor, JCET, etc.).
* Willingness to travel up to 25% for onsite supplier engagement, engineering builds, and production ramp support.
* Strong understanding of: Silicon manufacturing processes, including wafer fabrication, dicing, bumping, CoWoS packaging, and testing;
* Proficiency in using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel skills or analytics tools.
* Experience with hardware validation cycles and managing silicon hardware logistics.
* Exceptional program management and organizational skills with the ability to handle complex timelines and interdependencies.
* Effective communicator and cross\-functional leader across engineering, validation, and operations teams.

**Strong candidates may also have**
===================================

* Experience working on advanced process nodes (e.g., 5nm, 3nm).
* Familiarity with ATE platforms (Teradyne, Advantest) and test program infrastructure.
* Prior experience managing silicon bring\-up in hyperscale computing, AI/ML, or high\-performance SoC environments.
* PMP certification or equivalent project/program management training.
* Familiarity with CoWoS or other 2\.5D/3D packaging technologies.

**Benefits**

* Full medical, dental, and vision packages, with generous premium coverage
* Housing subsidy of **$2,500/month** for those living within walking distance of the office
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

**How we’re different**


Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model\-specific hardware. Larger and larger training runs encourage companies to consolidate around fewer model architectures, which creates a market for single\-model ASICs.


We are a fully in\-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

jobs.title: Escalations Manager, Global Response Operations
jobs.description:
Global Response Operations (GRO) is Meta's frontline defense against threats to platform integrity, user safety, regulatory compliance, and advertiser support. The Response teams solve essential escalations, remediate the most critical issues, and respond to urgent risks and incidents. We respond when the stakes are highest: high\-priority escalations that demand speed, precision, coordination, and judgement. We work closely with our partners to fix gaps in our platforms. Our mandate is to manage complex and novel situations that require special care across Meta's Family of Apps, all surfaces and domains, all issue types and all user groups. We are transitioning to an agentic operating model where AI handles routine work and human experts focus on the cases, decisions, and system improvements that require judgment, creativity, and domain depth.You will own Meta's most complex, sensitive, and time\-critical escalations, where AI reaches its limits and expert human judgment determines the outcome. Working across all Meta surfaces, products, and issue types, you'll investigate and resolve high\-stakes situations spanning civic concerns, entertainment events, advertiser integrity, regulatory risk, and AI product failures. You'll serve as a domain expert and workflow contributor by designing how humans and AI work together, critically evaluating AI outputs, encoding your expertise into systems that scale, and supporting others to do the same. You'll lead or contribute to pods that drive measurable operational improvement. This role is for people who thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly to shifting priorities, and see AI as a force multiplier for better outcomes.This role requires review of content, issues and matters that can be offensive or disturbing, including but not limited to graphic violence, self\-harm, hate speech, abuse, and sexually explicit material. Meta provides resources and support for employees who work with sensitive content. This role will require regular scheduled weekend and holiday on\-call work, and some non\-scheduled crisis intervention.  

  

  

### **Escalations Manager, Global Response Operations Responsibilities:**

* \*\*Response \& Crisis Management\*\*\*
* Drive Meta's highest\-priority escalations to resolution: from initial triage through investigation, cross\-functional coordination, and final resolution, ensuring time\-sensitive cases are mitigated within SLA and with minimal business or reputational impact
* Conduct rigorous, multi\-system investigations: connect signals across surfaces and stakeholders on complex or novel case types (LLM hallucinations, AI agent misbehavior, deepfake/synthetic media, cross\-platform integrity failures), producing root cause analysis and documentation that prevents recurrence
* Coordinate across Policy, Legal, Engineering, Sales, Communications, Leadership, and other XFN: drive aligned response strategies on cases carrying reputational, legal, or business risk, translating complexity into clear decisions and accountable next steps
* Synthesize and deliver executive\-level communications: leverage AI to ensure accurate, actionable situational awareness reaches leadership and partners when it matters
* Exercise judgment on unprecedented situations: make high\-stakes calls and set precedent for continuous improvement
* Work on\-call shifts within a global team: maintain 24/7 readiness and operate effectively across time zones, delivering consistent quality and decision\-making during high\-priority escalations
* \*\*Human \+ AI Orchestration\*\*\*
* Contribute to workflow performance in your domain: support end\-to\-end quality across HITL and HOTL deployments, identifying when intervention is needed and flagging issues that affect automated outputs
* Translate expert human judgment into encodable logic: convert tacit domain knowledge (policy interpretation, contextual reasoning, edge case intuition) into explicit rules, prompts, and decision frameworks that AI systems can execute
* Lead or contribute to sprints and pods that transform operations: drive measurable improvements in efficiency, effectiveness, and performance outcomes
* Design and iterate on AI\-assisted workflows (prompts, decision trees, runbooks, automations): increase team throughput, measured by reduced handling time, enhanced outcomes, or eliminated manual steps for recurring case patterns
* Support peer development on judgment, AI tool mastery, and escalation calibration: share expertise through case reviews and real\-time modeling, contributing to the team's collective capability
* Conduct case quality reviews: identify patterns in errors and AI failures
* implement corrections that raise the bar for the team
* \*\*AI Judging and Design\*\*\*
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated assessments, investigation outputs, and recommended actions: correct and document failure patterns, feeding structured improvements back into the system so accuracy improves over time
* Identify when regulatory, policy, or operational context changes require capability updates: proactively flag when existing automation rules, prompts, or decision logic have become stale due to external shifts, ensuring systems reflect current reality
* Provide structured feedback on AI launches: deliver actionable recommendations for improvement based on operational experience
* Design escalation logic, runbooks, and decision trees for AI systems: define how AI handles edge cases and when it routes to humans
* Create and maintain AI prompts, playbooks, and evaluation rubrics: build the tooling layer that governs AI performance in your domain
* Test and validate new AI capabilities before deployment: ensure quality and reliability before workflows go live
* Design AI skills and capabilities to check and copilot human work: build manual and human\-in\-the\-loop quality mechanisms into operational processes
* \*\*Domain expertise \& signal generation\*\*\*
* Develop and maintain deep domain expertise:

jobs.title: Program Manager, Data Center Investments and Development
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in technology, infrastructure development, real estate investment, or management consulting environments.
* Experience designing and running organizational rhythms, including OKR/KPI setting, Annual Operating Plans (AOP), Long\-Range Capacity Plans, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
* Experience eliminating multi\-stakeholder approval bottlenecks, and establish standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Analytical background in maintaining clean, auditable agreement databases (e.g., Salesforce, custom pipeline trackers, GIS databases) to empower leadership with actionable business intelligence.
* Familiarity with commercial real estate agreement structures, land acquisition due diligence, colocation/wholesale leasing, zoning, environmental reviews, and utility interconnection timelines.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments, unblocking urgent deadlocks.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Development Pipeline and Business Operation (DPBO) team supports land acquisitions and data center leasing through data integrity oversight, development of standard operating procedures, policies and best practices, and deployment of AI tools aimed at streamlining the agreement flow. Members of the team contribute at each milestone, from site selection/intake/origination, through approvals, on to asset management. As markets shift, and business needs evolve, DPBO is at the frontline, adjusting course so the greater Data Center Investments and Development (DCID) team can respond.


DPBO also serves as the connective tissue between DCID and cross\-functional teams, coordinating collaboration and translating priorities. This gives DPBO a birds\-eye view of the entire data center life\-cycle, allowing team members to develop high\-leverage expertise across acquisitions, contracting, technology and business operations.


As the Operations and Strategic Program Manager for the DCID Public Affairs Manager team, you will serve as the backbone and strategic team multiplier to ensure Google's license to operate. Navigating the critical intersection of programmatic management, strategy, communications, and business operations, you will assist the organization’s business cadence, including program management and delivery, contract management, OKRs, quarterly business reviews, yearly budgeting, and executive communications. You will partner closely with leadership and organizational stakeholders to establish standard operating procedures, govern data integrity, and design frictionless approval workflows. Additionally, you will represent DCID across technical, financial, and real estate teams, as you ensure seamless cross\-functional alignment, elevate data\-driven decision\-making, foster continuous organizational learning across the data center delivery lifecycle and ensure strategic priorities are translated into scalable operational frameworks.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide operational and programmatic support for public affairs managers, tasked with leading local engagement around data center investments and development, including, but not limited to: contract management, drafting of program charters, budget tracking and financial compliance, and pipeline reporting.
* Serve as an articulate, credible ambassador representing Google in select public forums, civic engagements, and community stakeholder panels.
* Work with leadership to craft internal, organization\-wide communications, bridge communication gaps between functional silos (e.g., Engineer, Finance, Legal, BizOps), manage leadership communications, and plan organization\-wide meetings and learning opportunities.
* Compile, organize and present programmatic metrics to leadership, and serve as point person for organization\-wide directives, such as OKRs, yearly budgets and quarterly business reviews.
* Serve as the connective tissue between DCID/PAMs and cross\-functional teams, coordinating collaboration and translating priorities.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

A. POSITION PURPOSE


Under the supervision of the Sr. Assistant Dean / Chief Operating Officer and in close coordination with project co\-leads, the Project Manager provides administrative, operational, and tactical leadership for the implementation of the $10 Million Lilly Endowment Large\-Scale Collaboration Grant. This 5\-year grant project supports the launch and integration of the Pope Francis Institute for Pastoral Flourishing (PFI), the relocation and integration of JST\-SCU into Santa Clara University’s main campus, and the expansion of regional and national network partnerships.


The Project Manager serves as the primary operational engine driving daily grant activities. This position is responsible for ensuring all strategic deliverables, sub\-project timelines, inter\-departmental workflows, budget tracking, and official compliance reporting to the Lilly Endowment are executed seamlessly, accurately, and on schedule.


B. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


1\. Grant Project Management \& Operational Execution


* Serve as the central point of tactical execution, project tracking, and workflow management for all initiatives funded under the $10M Lilly LSC Grant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive master project plans, timelines, work breakdown structures, and milestone tracking frameworks across all grant components.
* Monitor day\-to\-day progress across project working groups, internal SCU departments (JST, GPPM, Religious Studies), and external collaborating partners.
* Manage the operational roadmap for Year 1 ("Year of Co\-Design"), coordinating inter\-departmental task forces, curriculum alignment teams, and committee deliverables.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, risks, or schedule deviations, implementing corrective action plans to maintain project momentum.

2\. Centralized Compliance, Financial Tracking \& Grant Reporting


* Manage overall compliance with Lilly Endowment Grant Agreement terms, conditions, and reporting requirements.
* Partner closely with SCU Office of Sponsored Projects (SPO), JST Finance, and University Development to monitor the $10M budget, track expenditure allocations, approve line\-item disbursements, and manage sub\-award contracts.
* Coordinate, write, and submit all annual narrative program reports and collaborate with the SPO to submit financial reports to the Lilly Endowment by established deadlines.
* Collect, aggregate, and verify project data, revenue match metrics, and qualitative/quantitative outcomes from constituent units (such as CLTM, PFI, and external partner networks) for centralized reporting.
* Oversee budget revision requests and line\-item reallocations in accordance with Lilly Endowment policy guidelines.

3\. Stakeholder Coordination \& Governance Support


* Facilitate regular communication, meeting schedules, documentation, and reporting streams for the Grant Steering Committee, Advisory Boards, and Working Groups.
* Serve as the primary liaison between internal academic units and external partner organizations (e.g., ACHTUS, RECOSS, Iskali, regional dioceses, Discerning Deacons), managing partner contracts, stipends, and joint project deliverables.
* Maintain central project repositories, shared documentation, communications archives, and collaborative platforms (e.g., Google Workspace/Drive) to ensure transparent governance.

4\. Communications, Dissemination \& Logistics


* Coordinate the execution of project events, national symposia, planning retreats, workshops, and advisory council meetings in collaboration with project staff.
* Implement the grant’s strategic communication and dissemination plan, sharing project insights, best practices, and research outputs with national theological networks and peer institutions.
* Maintain systematic evaluation data and performance indicators to measure long\-term institutional impact and pastoral reach.

5\. Other duties as assigned in support of JST’s mission and operational needs


C. PROVIDES WORK DIRECTION


May at times, directly supervise grant\-funded project personnel, logistics coordinators, and graduate student assistants. Provides cross\-functional project direction and milestone tracking for grant task force leads across partner departments.


D. GENERAL GUIDELINES


Establishes robust project tracking systems and monitors task completion across multiple independent workstreams.


Identifies operational risks early and formulates actionable recommendations for project leads and committee chairs.


Maintains continuous communication with internal SCU administrators, external partners, and grant officers.


Ensures strict adherence to institutional accounting policies, grant agreement terms, and federal/foundation compliance regulations.


Prepares comprehensive progress dashboards and status briefs for executive leadership.


E. QUALIFICATIONS


1\. Knowledge


* Thorough understanding of formal project management methodologies, lifecycle frameworks, and grant administration tools.
* Familiarity with private foundation grant administration (experience with Lilly Endowment grants or higher education sponsored programs highly preferred).
* Understanding of university organizational structures, academic administration, and multi\-institutional collaborative networks.
* Knowledge of Catholic ecclesiology, ministerial formation, and the pastoral realities in the United States preferred.
* Strong understanding of the values, ideals, and mission of Jesuit higher education and the Jesuit School of Theology preferred.
* Knowledge of ATS\-accredited graduate theological education preferred.

Description:

If you're passionate about restoring California's natural landscapes and want to be involved in the entire restoration process from concept through implementation and long\-term success, this is an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact. As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you'll help lead and grow HELIX's expanding habitat restoration practice in Northern California while working alongside a team that designs, builds, monitors, and maintains restoration projects entirely in\-house.

**Why HELIX?**


At HELIX Environmental Planning, we take pride in delivering innovative environmental solutions that make a meaningful difference. Our team works on diverse public and private sector projects across California, from coastal habitats to mountain ecosystems and the Central Valley. What sets HELIX apart is our ability to handle every stage of habitat restoration under one roof, from planning and permitting to plant propagation, field implementation, and biological monitoring. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** role offers a unique chance to join a growing Northern California team and help shape the future of our restoration services. We offer a flexible hybrid work schedule with a combination of in\-office and remote work.

**Day in the Life**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, no two days are the same. You may start your morning collaborating with biologists and restoration practitioners on a large\-scale habitat restoration design, spend the afternoon evaluating a field site, and finish the day helping secure funding for future restoration efforts. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** works closely with regulatory agencies, field crews, project managers, and clients while helping lead restoration projects from planning through implementation and adaptive management.

**What You'll Do**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you will:

* Design and support habitat restoration projects to achieve project goals and success criteria.
* Lead site investigations and restoration feasibility assessments.
* Collaborate with field restoration crews during project implementation and adaptive management.
* Develop habitat restoration plans and support environmental permitting efforts.
* Assist with restoration grant applications and project development.
* Conduct and oversee biological surveys, vegetation mapping, and special\-status species surveys.
* Lead biological monitoring for restoration and construction projects.
* Support wetland permit applications and regulatory documentation.
* Participate in business development, proposal preparation, and project interviews.
* Travel occasionally overnight as project needs require.

**Compensation**


Salary will be based on qualifications and/or experience, with a robust benefits package. Expected starting pay range of **$130,000 to $160,000**.

**Ready to Grow Your Career?**


If you're an experienced **Senior Restoration Project Manager** looking to advance habitat restoration throughout Northern California while helping build and grow a thriving restoration program, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and join HELIX in creating positive environmental outcomes that last for generations.


HELIX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and an inclusive work environment. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of gender, race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or veteran status. These protections extend to all management practices and decisions, including recruitment and hiring, appraisal systems, promotions, training, and career development programs.


PM21


Requirements:
**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Botany, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of professional experience as a biologist, restoration ecologist, or restoration practitioner.
* At least 2 years of experience working in Northern California.
* Experience with field data collection methods and habitat restoration implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Ability to hike long distances across varied terrain and weather conditions.
* Valid California Driver's License with a clean driving record.
* Ability to travel overnight occasionally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Environmental consulting experience.
* Society for Ecological Restoration CERP certification.
* ISA Arborist Certification.
* Wetland Delineation or Professional Wetland Scientist certifications.
* Experience coordinating with regulatory agencies.
* ArcGIS field data collection experience.
* Experience with plant propagation, equipment operation, or herbicide application.
* Experience leading biological surveys, monitoring programs, and environmental compliance efforts.
