**Who are we?**

  

Thank you for asking! Kindness and curiosity are some of Atelier Ten’s core tenets.

  

We are a team of environmental designers and carbon strategists championing for a healthier planet by leveraging our vast, collective knowledge of sustainable spaces. We help bring beauty and efficiency to every building, because like Maybelline, not all buildings are “born with it.” We work with architects, engineers, owners, and other stakeholders to accomplish their sustainability, wellness, functionality, and visual goals. We don’t just follow the trends of the industry, we trailblaze new paths to create high performance, sustainable, and award\-winning buildings.  



  

Atelier Ten is a member company of Surbana Jurong (“SJ”), a global urban, infrastructure and managed services consulting firm based in more than 120 offices across 40 countries.

  

Let’s take a moment to see the overview of the role before we get into the nitty gritty.

  

We want you to be Atelier Ten San Francisco’s newest full\-time Environmental Designer with a specialty in Energy Analysis with the goal of collaborating on projects to achieve energy efficiency and carbon emissions reduction goals. You would help produce technical deliverables, perform whole building energy modeling, develop engineering strategies for building systems (HVAC), consult on projects, and lead the industry in decarbonizing the built environment. You would be an integral member of an interdisciplinary environmental design consulting group and a key member of the company’s Energy Analysis practice.

 **What is this role on a high level?**


Let’s take a moment to see the overview of the role before we get into the nitty gritty.


We’re looking for Atelier Ten San Francisco’s newest full\-time Senior Environmental Designer. In this role, you’ll consult on and manage projects (based on your experience and capability) under the guidance of an Associate and/or Director. Beyond leading exciting projects, you’ll maintain strong client and design community relationships, participate in meetings, support or lead design charrettes, and ensure clear, effective communication across teams. You’ll also take ownership of reporting, budgeting, and time management to keep projects on track and deliver exceptional results.

 **What your day\-to\-day looks like?**

  

Days at Atelier Ten are filled with a large variety of project types from offices, labs to large masterplans. We promise to keep you challenged and never bored. Here are some regular tasks you may encounter:

  

* Independently and proactively plan and manage projects from start to finish
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through clear communication and responsive service
* Coordinate with design and contractor teams to ensure seamless project delivery
* Lead client presentations, design charrettes, and internal team meetings
* Collaborate with Atelier Ten’s technical analysis teams to integrate sustainability strategies into your projects
* Forecast project fees and resources, and manage budgets effectively
* Author and review project deliverables, including reports, memos, technical studies, and drawings
* Create compelling graphic illustrations to communicate technical concepts across our consulting practices
* Work on a diverse range of projects within the built environment, including institutional, commercial, and residential buildings, as well as large\-scale masterplans
* Partner with Atelier Ten’s integrated design groups to support services such as environmental design consulting, daylight and façade analysis, and benchmarking

 **What we are looking for?**


Hopefully you’re on board so far and excited about what your days at Atelier will look like. We do have a few items on our wish list for you to become the next great A10er. We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, self\-motivated with an appreciation and willingness to learn on multiple projects.  



  

And if we’re not pushing our luck with asks, you ideally will possess:

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in a field related to environmental building design, architecture, architectural engineering, and/ or building science
* 5\-10 years’ professional experience in an architecture, engineering or sustainability consulting firm·
* LEED, or WELL AP with specialty certification preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel and Word
* Strong ability in visual communication and sketching
* In addition, experience with software such as “R,” Grasshopper, Radiance, Revit, eQuest, EnergyPlus, IES, D3, or data visualization would be desirable
* Experience with AutoCAD, Rhino or graphics software (Adobe Illustrator and InDesign) a plus
* Effective time and budget management capability
* Strong technical and business writing skills
* Good verbal and inter\-personal ability

 **What to expect from us?**

* Competitive salary
* 100% paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Generous paid time off
* Flexible / hybrid work schedule
* Emphasis on work life balance
* 401k matching program
* Highly engaged coworkers with a shared hunger for knowledge
* Mutual respect and support from colleagues and leadership
* Paid Life and Disability insurance
* Paid parental leave
* Paid volunteer time
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Annual professional development funds
* Freedom to contribute ideas and make a personal difference that is not always possible in a large corporate environment
* Really good high\-fives

  

Atelier Ten US seeks to compensate staff based on a variety of factors related to the role and the candidate. These factors include (but not limited to) the responsibilities, requirements, and location of the position, as well as the candidate/s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

Reporting to the Director of Digital Marketing, this role supports the SambaNova digital ecosystem, including sambanova.ai and the SambaAcademy educational partner portal, and collaborates with teams managing SambaCloud and our Documentation site to ensure a consistent user experience. * Maintain the design system and component library so pages stay consistent as the site grows.
* Run the governance layer: page request process, naming conventions, approvals, and documentation.

* Own site performance and Core Web Vitals; partner with developers on page speed, caching, and technical fixes.

* Monitor uptime, broken links, form failures, and integration errors; fix or escalate.

* Work with design team and web development agencies: project scope, timelines, and quality of delivery.
* Translate business requests into clear technical requirements.
* Partner with marketing ops on forms, lead routing, and CRM handoffs so every page feeds the funnel correctly.
* Manage translation service to ensure content updates are also localized for Japanese pages.
* Report on web performance and roadmap status to marketing leadership on a regular cadence.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree.
* Hands\-on HubSpot or WordPress CMS expertise: building and publishing, not just reviewing.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive design; enough technical depth to evaluate developer work and debug an issue.
* Analytics fluency. GA4 and Google Tag Manager, with a standard of using data to decide next steps.
* Demonstrated project management across competing stakeholders and deadlines, with the judgment to prioritize.

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.


Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.


Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.


We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description** **About the Role**


We are seeking highly motivated and experienced Transmission Project Managers to oversee the successful planning, execution, and delivery of electric transmission projects. This role is responsible for leading cross\-functional teams, managing project schedules and budgets, mitigating risks, and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in compliance with regulatory and customer requirements.


The ideal candidate combines strong project leadership skills with a deep understanding of transmission systems, utility operations, engineering processes, and capital project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of transmission projects, including planning, engineering, procurement, construction, and closeout activities.
* Develop and manage project schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource plans.
* Coordinate with engineering, environmental, permitting, construction, and operations teams to ensure project success.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, leadership teams, customers, contractors, and regulatory agencies.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while proactively resolving issues that may impact project objectives.
* Monitor project performance and provide regular status updates, forecasts, and executive\-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, environmental regulations, and company policies.
* Manage contractor and vendor performance to ensure quality, cost control, and schedule adherence.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and implement best practices in project delivery.
* Support strategic planning efforts and contribute to the development of transmission infrastructure programs.
* SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience managing utility, transmission, energy infrastructure, or large\-scale capital projects.
* Proven experience leading complex, multi\-disciplinary project teams.
* Strong knowledge of transmission systems, utility operations, and project delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, contracts, and risk management processes.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or similar platforms.

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.
* Experience with transmission line, substation, and grid modernization projects in the US and/or Canada.
* Knowledge of NERC, FERC, and utility regulatory requirements.
* Experience working within investor\-owned utilities, EPC firms, or energy infrastructure organizations.


Key Competencies

* Strategic Leadership
* Project Execution Excellence
* Risk Management
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Customer\-driven
* Financial and Budget Management
* Problem Solving and Decision Making
* Team Leadership and Collaboration
* Safety\-First Mindset

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

At Jacobs, we are seeking to have a **Resilience Project Manager** based out of **San Francisco or San Jose, CA** join our California Water team. As a Resilience Project Manager, you will support planning, coordination, and delivery of resilience and climate adaptation projects in the region. Work with multidisciplinary teams to advance projects from early planning through design and construction, with a focus on complex urban waterfront and coastal resilience programs. Interface between planning and engineering to manage project delivery, coordinate technical disciplines, and translate flood risk science and engineering analysis into strategies that decision\-makers, communities, and partner agencies can act on. Beyond project delivery, you will support business development and contribute to building our resilience practice.

  

  

What You'll Do:


* Project Delivery: Manage delivery of resilience and flood risk projects across planning, design, and construction phases, including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and QA/QC. Oversee multidisciplinary project teams spanning engineering, environmental, and planning disciplines. Mentor and develop junior staff across technical and project management capabilities.
* Engineering Team Interface: Coordinate engineering teams through design development, review deliverables, and interpret hydraulic modeling, flood risk analysis, and coastal engineering outputs to inform project decisions and communicate findings to decision\-makers and public audiences.
* Interagency Coordination and Community Engagement: Lead coordination with public agency clients, city departments, and federal, state, and regional partners. Support community engagement and co\-design processes that center equity and ensure project outcomes reflect community priorities alongside technical and environmental performance.
* Resilience and Adaptation Strategy: Contribute to vulnerability assessments, flood risk analyses, and adaptation strategy development. Support development and evaluation of adaptation alternatives using frameworks that consider hazard reduction, equity, environmental performance, social value, cost, and implementation feasibility – across a range of adaptation project, program, and policy options.
* Communication and Public Presentation: Prepare briefings, decision memos, technical summaries, and presentations for senior leadership, elected officials, regulatory bodies, and public audiences. Deliver public presentations to community groups, stakeholder forums, and interagency audiences.
* Business Development and Practice Building: Support pursuit of new project opportunities through proposal development and client relationship building. Contribute to growing the resilience and adaptation practice through thought leadership and cross\-project collaboration.
  

  

\#LI\-AC2


Here's what you'll need
* Bachelor's degree in Geography, Environmental Science, Urban Planning, Environmental Management, Public Policy, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in flood risk management, climate adaptation, coastal resilience, or related infrastructure and environmental program delivery.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary project teams to coordinate technical delivery, review engineering and design outputs, and maintain QA/QC standards.
* Experience working with public agency clients and coordinating across multiple government agencies and stakeholders in complex urban or infrastructure settings.
* Ability to communicate complex technical information to senior decision\-makers, elected officials, and public audiences, including delivering public presentations.
* Familiarity with flood risk assessment, sea level rise, coastal hazards, or climate adaptation planning frameworks sufficient to engage with and direct technical teams.
  
  

Ideally, you'll also have:


* Master's degree in Climate Science, Environmental Policy, Urban Planning, Water Resources, Coastal Management, or related field.
* Project management credentials (PMP or equivalent) or professional credentials in environmental or water management (e.g., CFM, ENV SP).
* Experience with large\-scale flood defense, waterfront resilience, or coastal adaptation programs, including oversight of engineering design development from concept through construction.
* Familiarity with adaptation pathways approaches, including weaving governance structures, funding mechanisms, and institutional decision\-making into physical adaptation strategies.
* Experience helping clients structure phased investments that respond to evolving conditions.
* Experience with nature\-based solutions, multi\-criteria evaluation of adaptation alternatives, benefit\-cost analysis, or business case development for public infrastructure investment.
* Experience with equity\-focused analysis, social vulnerability assessment, social value frameworks, or community co\-design in the context of resilience or infrastructure planning.
* Experience with spatial planning, urban design, and/or landscape approaches for integrating adaptation measures into multibenefit improvements.
* Understanding of relevant regulatory frameworks, which may include USACE Section 408/NEPA, CEQA, BCDC, or FEMA floodplain management.

**Why Harvey**
==============


At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.


This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.


Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.


At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


**Role Overview**
=================


Harvey ships fast, and our customers tell us constantly what's working and what isn't — through CSMs, support, sales, and early\-access programs. Today that signal lives in a hundred places and reaches Product inconsistently, and the systems that let the EPD organization plan, review, and fix things at scale are still being built. You will own those systems: a single Voice of the Customer program that turns scattered feedback into structured, trusted input for every product team; a bug management process that gets defects triaged, prioritized, and resolved predictably; and the operating rhythm that keeps Engineering, Product, and Design aligned. You own the infrastructure and cadence; embedded Product Operations Managers own the interpretation and day\-to\-day judgment for their product areas.


**What You'll Do**
==================


### **Voice of the Customer Program**


* Design and stand up the end\-to\-end feedback pipeline: intake from CS, Support, Sales, and EAPs into one structured system
* Partner with RevOps to design \& implement tooling; define the workflows that make submitting feedback the easy default for field teams
* Set the weekly triage cadence and SLAs so every piece of signal is classified, routed, and visible
* Build reporting that Product, GTM, and leadership actually read — volume, themes, trends, and what changed
* Own the classification model: product area, matter stage, root cause (missing capability, defect, or usability friction)
* Give Design and Research standing views into the signal that matters to them

### **Product Operating Rhythm**


* Design and run the core engineering, product \& design rituals: planning cycles, roadmap reviews, design reviews, and monthly business reviews
* Build the run\-of\-business systems that scale as Harvey grows — intake frameworks, RACI structures, decision logs, shared calendars
* Facilitate roadmap planning by coordinating inputs across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM and maintaining transparency across the org
* Make it clear across Harvey what EPD is building, how it's progressing, and what's coming next
* Own the end\-to\-end bug lifecycle: intake from Support and the field, severity definitions, triage, routing to engineering teams, and resolution tracking
* Define severity and SLA standards that CS, Support, and Engineering all agree to and can see
* Run the recurring bug review with engineering and product leads; escalate aging or customer\-impacting defects
* Report bug volume, aging, and resolution trends by product area, and connect defect signal back into the Voice of the Customer taxonomy
* Close the loop with Support and CS so customers hear when their issue is fixed

**What You Have**
=================


* 5\+ years in program management, product operations, or a related operational role at a high\-growth tech or SaaS company
* You've built processes and programs from scratch and scaled them — not just inherited and maintained them
* Hands\-on experience running bug triage or incident/defect management processes across Engineering and Support
* Experience designing and facilitating product development rituals — planning, reviews, prioritization — with senior engineering and design leaders
* Deep fluency with feedback, ticketing, and data tooling; you're comfortable owning a taxonomy and the systems that enforce it
* Ability to translate messy qualitative and quantitative input into clear, structured outputs
* Proven ability to drive alignment and adoption across CS, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering without direct authority
* Experience with AI\-native or highly technical products is a plus
* You create clarity where none exists, and you're energized by a blank slate

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**


As Senior Implementation Manager, Air (EHR), you will own the end\-to\-end implementation of onboarding and launching new customers on Athelas Air (EHR). You’ll partner with Engineering and Launch to ensure each practice transitions smoothly, on time, and with high adoption. You’ll build scalable launch playbooks; scope, define, and prioritize product features based on customer workflows; define success metrics; and continuously refine processes to accelerate time\-to\-value.


Read more about Air!

 **This full\-time position requires working 5 days a week in our Mountain View, CA office.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Customer Discovery, Workflow Analysis \& Technical Collaboration:**


	+ Engage directly with customers to map their existing clinical and administrative workflows.
* **Product Management \& Technical Specifications:**


	+ Draft detailed functional and technical specifications (user stories, acceptance criteria, data mappings, interface requirements) based on scoped customer needs.
	+ Partner with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility, clarify requirements, and prioritize specs in the development backlog.
* **Project Leadership \& Stakeholder Coordination:**


	+ Develop and maintain detailed implementation plans, timelines, and resource allocations for each customer launch.
	+ Lead cross\-functional launch teams through weekly status calls, playbook adherence, and risk\-mitigation workflows.
	+ Act as the primary operations liaison among Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and Support.
	+ Align on deliverables, dependencies, and hand\-offs; flag and escalate critical\-path issues early.
* **Process Design, Optimization \& Tooling:**


	+ Create and evolve scalable, standardized launch playbooks and templates for data migration, build\-out, training, and go\-live support.
	+ Identify bottlenecks and implement continuous improvements to reduce time\-to\-launch and increase launch quality.
	+ Build and maintain internal Retool applications to streamline operational workflows and empower non\-technical stakeholders to create custom dashboards, reports, and tools without code.
* **Go\-Live Support \& Adoption:**


	+ Facilitate hypercare support during and immediately after go\-live; track issue\-resolution SLAs.
	+ Monitor and report on key adoption metrics (e.g., login rates, documentation volume, billing task completion).

**What You Have**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree a plus.
* **Experience:**


	+ **5\+ years** of operations or project management experience in SaaS or HealthTech.
	+ Proven track record of leading complex, cross\-functional programs to successful delivery on time and within scope.


Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

  

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.


Compensation Range: $120K \- $160K

jobs.title: Program Manager, Security Risk Program
jobs.description:
We are building a governance, risk, and compliance function to enable our company to buildproducts that can withstand regulatory scrutiny, and ensure Meta continues to meet globalregulatory requirements and manage risk. Meta's Risk and Compliance Program (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. Within RCP, the Security Risk Program (SRP) is the second\-line function accountable for how Meta identifies, assesses, quantifies, and reports its security risk posture — delivering global security risk assessments, Capability Maturity \& Effectiveness (CME) evaluations, AI and cloud risk assessments, and board\-level and regulatory reporting.We are seeking a Security Risk Program Manager to build one of the program's highest\-priority new capabilities: security risk assessment of AI product launches. Today, AI launches receivead\-hoc coverage through security risk assessments designed for infrastructure — not forproduct\-launch cadence, and not for cross\-domain AI risk spanning Security, Privacy, Integrity,and Legal. You will design that capability from the ground up and scale it from roughly fiveassessments per quarter today to twenty or more per quarter by H1 2027, in step with Meta's AIproduct velocity.This is a builder and an influencer role in equal measure. AI launch risk cannot beassessed by one function acting alone — it requires Central Security, product groups, Privacy,Integrity, and Legal moving through a shared process on a launch timeline. You will own thatoperating model: translating product and engineering reality into a defensible risk position, andtranslating regulatory obligation into assessment work that product teams can actually absorbwithout stalling a launch. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, effective inhigh\-pressure and fast\-moving situations, and able to build durable relationships across a widerange of technical and non\-technical stakeholders.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, Security Risk Program Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement Meta's AI Launch Risk Assessment framework end to end — intake criteria, cross\-domain risk taxonomy, assessment methodology, and launch\-gate outputs — and scale delivery from \~5 to 20\+ assessments per quarter by H1 2027\.
* Build and partner to manage the XFN operating model that coordinates Central Security, product groups, Privacy Risk Management, Integrity Risk Management, and Legal through each assessment, with clear roles, handoffs, and decision rights on a launch timeline.
* Partner directly with product and engineering teams on high\-priority AI launches — engaging early enough that security risk review informs design decisions rather than gating release, and giving product teams a predictable, well\-documented path through second\-line review.
* Serve as the connection point between the Security Risk Program, Central Security leadership, Legal, and first\-line business teams, representing security risk positions and negotiating assessment scope, sequencing, and remediation commitments.
* Build and maintain a consolidated AI risk register that gives leadership a single view of.
* security risk across the AI product portfolio, and produce the reporting that keeps that view current for VP and executive audiences.
* Define tooling requirements and drive AI\-enabled automation across the assessment lifecycle — identifying where automation can scale throughput without compromising assessment defensibility, and partnering with tooling and engineering owners to deliver it.
* Ensure assessments and supporting artifacts are produced to internal standards, are.
* submission\-ready, and constitute defensible evidence of systematic security due diligence for regulators and auditors (including EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF expectations).
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers across the program, define mitigation plans, monitor key delivery and SLA metrics, and drive corrective action with stakeholders when performance deviates.
* Create and facilitate presentations that build senior leadership understanding and influence decision\-making, and provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members on program design and assessment practice.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of experience in governance, risk, and compliance, security risk management,
* Regulatory compliance, or a directly related discipline
* 2\+ years of program management experience in a corporate environment
* Experience with risk and compliance precepts, practices, and solutions
* Experience designing a program or process from the ground up — not solely running an established one — including methodology, operating model, and rollout
* Experience driving cross\-functional alignment across technical and non\-technical partners without direct authority, including with engineering or product organizations
* Proven verbal and written communication skills, with success influencing a range of audiences including senior leadership

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience assessing or managing risk for AI or machine learning systems, or familiarity with AI\-specific regulatory and risk frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF)
* Experience embedding risk, security, or compliance review into a fast\-moving product
* Development lifecycle and launch process
* Experience working in information security and/or cybersecurity
* Experience partnering with a central security or infrastructure security

jobs.description:
POSITION: IT Systems \& Project Coordinator  
DEPARTMENT: Informational Technology  
REPORTS TO: Associate Director of Strategy  
LOCATION: 2920 International Blvd., Oakland, CA  
Native American Health Center, Inc. (NAHC)  
WORK HOURS: Full Time, 40 hours per week, 100% FTE  
STATUS: Non\-Union, Non\-Exempt  


POSITION SUMMARY  
The IT Systems \& Project Coordinator I supports IT leadership and operations by managing administrative workflows, coordinating projects, maintaining departmental organization, and ensuring efficient execution of IT processes. This role serves as a central point of coordination across IT functions, supporting project execution, vendor management, inventory and procurement, compliance responsibilities, and internal communications.  


The Native American Health Center is an accredited institution and adheres to the standards of excellence set forth by the Accreditation Association of Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC) and the Commission of Dental Accreditation (CODA).  


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: IT Operations \& Administrative Coordination:  
1\. Manage and monitor IT intake channels (e.g., ticketing system, shared inbox, phone line), ensuring timely routing, tracking and resolution of requests.  
2\. Maintain IT calendars, schedules and coordinate department meetings.  
3\. Prepare meeting agendas, document meeting minutes, track action items.  
4\. Serve as a central point of coordination for internal and external IT\-related communications.  
5\. Maintain organized electronic and physical records for IT operations, projects, and documentation.  
6\. Provide administrative support to IT leadership, including coordination and tracking of staff timesheets, scheduling, and related administrative processes as needed.  


Project Coordination \& Execution  
7\. Support and lead administrative and operational components of IT projects.  
8\. Track project timelines, deliverables, and action items to ensure project progress and completion.  
9\. Coordinate with IT team members and other departments to ensure alignment and follow\-through.  
10\. Assist with gathering, organizing, and summarizing data for project planning and reporting.  


Procurement \& Inventory Management  
11\. Oversee IT inventory management, including tracking, auditing and maintaining accurate records of equipment and supplies.  
12\. Coordinate procurement of IT equipment and supplies, including vendor sourcing, price comparisons, and order tracking.  
13\. Ensure timely processing of purchases and delivery of equipment to appropriate locations.  
14\. Support lifecycle management of IT assets, including intake, tracking and decommissioning.  


Vendor \& Financial Coordination  
15\. Manage relationships with IT vendors and service providers for administrative and operational needs.  
16\. Process invoices, track expenses, and coordinate with the Finance Department to ensure timely payments and account accuracy.  
17\. Assist with budget tracking, expense reporting, and reconciliation of IT\-related purchases.  
18\. Support contract and documentation tracking for vendors and services.  


Compliance, Policy \& Audit Support  
19\. Maintain and manage IT policies and procedures, ensuring documents are current, organized, and accessible.  
20\. Serve as a key coordinator for IT\-related audits, security assessments, and accreditation processes.  
21\. Support documentation requests and data gathering for compliance and regulatory reviews.  
22\. Support documentation and tracking security\-related programs (e.g., Managed Phishing Testing \& Training Program, cybersecurity initiatives, employee trainings).  


Quality Assurance \& Reporting  
23\. Monitor IT service trends (e.g., ticket volume, response times) and identify areas for improvement.  
24\. Conduct routine audits of IT processes and systems to ensure accuracy and completion.  
25\. Prepare reports and summaries for IT leadership to support decision\-making.  


General Administrative Support  
26\. Prepare correspondence, reports, presentation and other materials as needed.  
27\. Respond to inquiries and provide information related to IT operations when appropriate.  
28\. Support cross\-functional initiatives and special projects assigned.  
29\. Work well under pressure, meet multiple and often competing deadlines, and demonstrate cooperative behavior with supervisors, subordinates, colleagues, clients and the community.  


Employee Safety  
30\. Safely perform all duties; follow required protective protocols to ensure personal safety as well as the safety of others.  
31\. Maintain compliance with ergonomic safety standards; be mindful of posture and regularly practice ergonomic stretches.  


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS  
1\. High School Diploma or its equivalent is required.  
2\. Two (2\) plus years of experience performing administrative support functions for department leaders.  
3\. Strong communication and coordination skills.  
4\. Experience coordinating and providing support for large complex projects.  
5\. Strong organizational and time management skills.  
6\. Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through independently.  
7\. Comfort working with technology systems and learning new tools.  
8\. Intermediate to advanced level proficiency with MS Office applications: Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel.  
9\. Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.  


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  
1\. Experience working in an IT setting and familiarity with IT equipment and terminology.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Active Clearance Required
jobs.description:
### **Company Description**


**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.


### **Job Description**


We have multiple openings for **Project Managers** to lead project\-management activities and support the planning and successful execution of high\-impact technical projects addressing critical national security challenges. You will serve as a key project\-management resource for milestone\-driven research and development efforts in a fast\-paced, multidisciplinary environment. Working closely with Associate Program Leaders, Principal Investigators, technical staff, and other project stakeholders, you will help organize project teams and coordinate schedules, budgets, milestones, risks, resources, agreements, reporting, and technical communications to enable successful project execution on aggressive timelines.


You will contribute to a growing portfolio of national security research and development initiatives in areas such as cyber\-physical systems assurance, national security infrastructure, supply chain security, and disaster resilience. This position provides an opportunity to apply project\-management, technical, and operational expertise to first\-of\-a\-kind national security work while helping technical teams effectively organize, plan, coordinate, and execute complex activities. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division within the Engineering Directorate.


*Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid work arrangement, blending in\-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.*


These positions will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.


**In this role, you will**


* Lead day\-to\-day project\-management activities for milestone\-driven technical projects across cyber and infrastructure domains, including schedules, deliverables, dependencies, resources, budgets, risks, and project documentation.
* Advise and support Associate Program Leaders and Principal Investigators in project team organization, resource coordination, budget tracking, scheduling, milestone planning, risk mitigation, and progress toward technical and programmatic objectives.
* Gather, analyze, and synthesize scientific and technical information for project reports, proposals, milestone deliverables, sponsor communications, and decision briefings.
* Coordinate technical and operational communications among project teams, collaborators, management, sponsors, and other stakeholders to support timely and effective project execution.
* Identify and recommend improvements to established project\-management and operational principles, methods, and tools to improve project execution, workflow, documentation, team coordination, and organizational processes.
* Coordinate documentation, schedules, deliverables, funding information, and other activities associated with contracts, subcontract\-related efforts, collaboration agreements, and external project partnerships.
* Implement, maintain, and contribute to the improvement of project\-management frameworks, tools, processes, and practices used to monitor budgets, schedules, resources, risks, milestones, and project performance.
* Organize and facilitate project and team meetings, including schedules, logistics, agendas, presentation materials, decisions, action items, and follow\-up activities.
* Coordinate with staff and project\-management personnel at other national laboratories and partner organizations to support communication, planning, team organization, resource coordination, milestones, and execution of multi\-laboratory projects and consortia.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Additional job responsibilities, at the TSS.3 level**

* Conduct complex technical and operational project\-coordination activities under minimal direction, developing approaches, priorities, and solutions necessary to support successful completion of project milestones and deliverables.
* Perform independent technical and operational analyses, synthesize project information, and develop recommendations to inform strategic project decisions involving schedules, budgets, resources, risks, priorities, and execution approaches.
* Analyze and resolve complex project execution issues requiring in\-depth analysis, ingenuity, and creative application of established project\-management, technical, and operational methods.
* Coordinate and prioritize multiple parallel activities involving competing requirements, changing priorities, or less well\-defined assignments, and provide project leadership for defined activities by coordinating contributors and guiding execution toward project objectives.

### **Qualifications**


* This position requires an active DOE Q\-level clearance or active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire.
* Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, project management, business, engineering, or a related technical field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
* Comprehensive knowledge of project\-management concepts, practices, and tools, with broad experience applying project\-management principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to technical or operational projects.
* Comprehensive experience independent

jobs.title: Clinician and Intensive Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM, BE THE DIFFERENCE!  


About the Role \| Why It's Exciting  


As a Clinician and Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC), you will provide evidence\-based therapy and coordinate comprehensive care for youth, caregivers, schools, and community providers. You will develop collaborative care plans that reflect each family's voice, strengthen relationships, and connect youth and families with the support they need. In this role, you will deliver high\-impact, community\-based behavioral health services in Contra Costa County for a respected nonprofit with more than 60 years of service to youth and families. Our collaborative, strengths\-based culture values your expertise, honors your lived experience, and actively supports your professional growth.  


What You Bring  


You're a compassionate clinician committed to trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and family\-centered care. You bring clinical judgment, organizational excellence, and the ability to manage complex cases. We serve clients with broad and complex needs, so would prefer candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:  


Complex trauma and attachment\-related challenges  


Autism Spectrum Disorder and neurodevelopmental conditions  


LGBTQ\+ affirming care and gender\-affirming practice  


Co\-occurring behavioral and physical health conditions  


Working with historically marginalized communities and addressing behavioral health disparities  


Bilingual English/Spanish skills are a plus and will be taken into consideration when factoring the overall compensation package, yet we welcome applications from all qualified candidates.  


Key Responsibilities  


Help Youth and Families Thrive  


Provide strengths\-based, trauma\-informed, and culturally responsive mental health care through comprehensive assessment, treatment planning, and individual and family therapy. Support youth and caregivers in building resilience, developing effective coping skills, strengthening family connections, and achieving meaningful treatment goals. Work with families from diverse cultural backgrounds and experiences.  


Lead Collaborative Care Coordination  


Facilitate Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings and case conferences with caregivers, service providers, and educators. Guide collaborative decision\-making, ensure every voice is heard, and align treatment plans with each family's strengths and goals.  


Drive Lasting Outcomes  


Coordinate services among schools, behavioral health providers, child welfare agencies, and community partners to ensure that youth and families receive connected, culturally responsive, and trauma\-informed support.  


Maintain Quality Documentation  


Maintain timely, high\-quality clinical documentation and ensure compliance with Medi\-Cal, HIPAA, and agency standards.  


Why Youth Homes?  


At Youth Homes, clinicians are trusted partners, advocates, and leaders. We support and encourage your growth through:  


Individual and group clinical supervision at no cost (clinical hours count toward BBS Licensure)  


Dedicated professional development for licensed providers pursuing Clinical Director or supervisor roles  


Fully agency\-sponsored training opportunities in trauma\-informed and culturally responsive practice  


Annual training stipend  


Flexible scheduling with hybrid and remote work options  


Mileage reimbursement  


Generous PTO plus 9 paid holidays and birthday time\-off  


Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits  


Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health support  


Compensation \& Career Path  


Starting annual salary:$71,316 \- $78,447, based on experience and licensure status. Licensed clinicians may negotiate higher compensation based on credentials and background. Bilingual differential: $3,000 or more annually. Clear career pathways exist for clinicians interested in supervision, program development, or leadership roles.  


Required Qualifications  


Master's degree in social work, Counseling, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or a related field  


Current registration or licensure with the California Board of Behavioral Sciences (A/LMFT, A/LCSW, A/LPCC)  


Commitment to trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and family\-centered care and strong clinical judgment, organizational skills, and ability to manage complex cases  


Other Requirements  


At least 21 years of age  


Successfully pass background checks, health screening and other licensing/certification requirements.  


Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license and personal auto insurance.  


If you are passionate about trauma\-informed, culturally responsive mental health care and ready to make a lasting impact in your community, we invite you to apply!  


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB): https://youthhomes.org/better\-together

* Organized, detail\-oriented individual able to work in a fast\-paced environment.

 **Benefits*** Medical, dental, and vision insurance

* Tuition Reimbursement

jobs.description:
**About Glide**
GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. Reporting to the Talent Manager, the HR Coordinator will be fully immersed in all areas of our hiring, recruitment and our onboarding processes. You will be responsible for administrative and logistical support for HR, but you will also be a key anchor for the recruitment team. Specifically, you will ensure the on and offboarding processes run smoothly, you will initiate the recruitment and posting of our positions and you will help coordinating our staff events. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for all new hires, and ensure each new hire has completed all required documentation and has the appropriate office set up.

Key Qualities needed for this role:
* You’re a proactive problem\-solver who keeps things moving behind the scenes with minimal direction.

### **Primary Responsibilities**


* This position will work collaborate across the hiring and training teams to ensure HR supports everything from pre\-boarding to offboarding, initiating and following up on operational Zendesk tickets, tracking recruitment processes.

Specifically, ensuring our jobs are posted in the ATS, work with hiring managers to schedule candidate interviews, and with an eye on details, continually update our job postings across different sites to promote and/or accelerate candidate flow.
* Be able to distribute internal job postings to staff, refresh job boards and update recruitment tracking sheet to ensure updates are recorded in a timely fashion.

GLIDE’s buildings are located in the Tenderloin neighborhood. GLIDE maintains an "open door" policy to the community and its clients, who frequently enter and leave the building.

Copia Resources CA, Inc. isn’t just another company. We are building an empire in the environmental services industry. If you’re looking for a cushy 9\-to\-5 where you can coast, this isn’t for you. We move fast, we solve problems, and we don’t settle for “good enough.”

If you’re proactive, solution\-oriented, and focused on delivering an exceptional client experience, this position is a perfect fit.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in customer service, operations, logistics, or a related field.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced environment requiring strong organization, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, field teams, and internal departments.
* Ability to manage difficult conversations with professionalism, empathy, and confidence.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable taking ownership of issues and driving them through resolution.

* Experience supporting remote teams, BPO teams, or customer service teams preferred.
* Environmental services, waste, logistics, transportation, or field operations experience preferred.
* Travel Requirement: Regular local and regional travel to client sites and company locations is required, with occasional out\-of\-state or international travel as needed.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Compensation: $75,000 per year.
* 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Partner Customer Success Manager (Accounting)
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


At Intuit, our Partner Success Managers (PSMs) are the **cornerstone of our relationship with our most influential accounting partners**. This role is a mission\-critical position that directly impacts the success of accounting firms who, in turn, recommend and manage our products for countless businesses. As a PSM, you will **own the end\-to\-end journey** for a portfolio of high\-value firms as a dedicated strategic partner and trusted advisor. This is a leadership role for someone who runs their book of business like an owner. You'll join at a stage where the approach is still taking shape — an opportunity to help refine and sharpen how this function operates, and to influence the model as it matures rather than simply inheriting a finished one. Your mission is to foster deep, lasting relationships, drive platform adoption, and quarterback complex integrations and implementations to ensure a seamless, premium VIP experience.

  

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product teams to ensure proactive engagement, and as a trusted advisor, help firms **unlock the full value of Intuit’s ecosystem in a seamless experience.** We’re looking for an entrepreneurial self\-starter — someone who is customer\-obsessed, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked, and treats every firm’s success as their own. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, customer\-centric environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are passionate about empowering our partners to succeed, this role is for you.

 **Responsibilities**

* Lead your portfolio like an owner: bring an entrepreneurial mindset to identify opportunities, make fast decisions, and drive outcomes proactively rather than reactively.
* Serve as a dedicated strategic partner, ensuring accounting firms fully leverage Intuit’s platform to meet their needs.
* Manage the end\-to\-end firm experience from implementation to renewal, connecting the right teams—Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product teams—to ensure a cohesive and high\-quality experience that drives accountant satisfaction and platform adoption.
* Act as an accountant advocate, anticipating challenges and coordinating with internal teams (Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product teams) to resolve issues efficiently, moving with speed and urgency to unblock firms.
* Conduct regular check\-ins, business reviews, and proactive outreach to assess firm health and provide guidance.
* Drive ongoing product education for firms on platform features, product capabilities, and best practice, helping them extract maximum value.
* Monitor key success metrics including support KPIs, usage trends, and subscription growth / attrition indicators to identify expansion and retention opportunities in partnership with the Sales team.
* Lead retention and renewal planning to ensure Accountants see long\-term value and remain engaged.
* Capture and translate recurring product pain points into roadmap insights, advocating for enhancements that improve the accountant experience.

 **Qualifications**

* Demonstrated leadership and an entrepreneurial mindset — a self\-starter who takes full ownership of outcomes, moves fast, and drives results independently in ambiguous situations.
* Comfortable working within an evolving framework — able to operate effectively today while helping refine and strengthen the approach as it develops.
* 3\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B client or partner engagement.
* Working understanding of accounting and bookkeeping fundamentals and accounting firm workflows, with 1\+ years experience in an accounting/bookkeeping environment.
* Strong background in accounting or bookkeeping, with a preference for experience in a mid\-market environment. This includes an understanding of complex financial management systems and familiarity with AI\-driven forecasting.
* Proven track record of driving product adoption, improving retention, and delivering business value within a large\-scale matrixed organization.
* Strategic problem solving skills and critical thinking to proactively identify risks and implement solutions. You can look beyond the "here and now" to foresee challenges and develop innovative solutions.
* Data\-driven mindset with proficiency in customer success tools (e.g., Quickbase, Salesforce) and analytics dashboards, leveraging insights to drive seamless firm experiences.
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills, capable of guiding Accounting Firms at all levels.
* 2\+ years experience in SaaS, cloud\-based enterprise solutions, or financial management platforms.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with Sales, Professional Services, and Product Support teams to drive seamless Accountant experience.
* Accounting or bookkeeping courses or certifications preferred.
* Up to 30% travel time to partner sites

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

jobs.title: Community Health Worker/Case Manager, VCC
jobs.description:
**About Swords to Plowshares**

Founded in 1974, Swords to Plowshares is a community\-based not\-for\-profit organization that provides counseling and case management, employment and training, housing, and legal assistance to veterans in the San Francisco Bay Area. We promote and protect the rights of veterans through advocacy, public education, and partnerships with local, state, and national entities. Believing that war causes wounds and suffering that last beyond the battlefield, our mission is to support veterans as they navigate the challenges of post\-military life, and to prevent and end veteran homelessness through wrap\-around care and informed advocacy. To learn more about Swords to Plowshares, please visit our website at www.swords\-to\-plowshares.org.  



**Job Title:** Community Health Worker/Case Manager, Veteran Community Center (VCC)


**Location:** 1060 Howard Street, San Francisco, CA 94103


**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 11 am – 7 pm


**Reporting Type:** In\-person


**Employment Type:** Non\-Exempt AND Full\-Time


**Salary Range:** $35\.33 per hour  



**Summary:**

The Community Health Worker/Case Manager provides trauma\-informed, person\-centered support to individuals experiencing barriers related to housing instability, mental health, substance use, medical needs, and access to community resources. This position serves as a bridge between clients, healthcare providers, and community\-based services by offering advocacy, care coordination, resource navigation, crisis intervention, and ongoing case management support.


The Community Health Worker/Case Manager works collaboratively with interdisciplinary teams to promote client wellness, stability, self\-sufficiency, and engagement in services while fostering a safe and supportive environment.  



**Responsibilities:**

Client Services:


* Actively engage clients by reviewing their enrollment packets with them, conducting intakes, and engaging regularly in case management services.

· Coordinate referrals to housing, behavioral health, substance use treatment, benefits, employment, and other supportive services.


* Assist clients in filling out applications for public benefits, identification documents, housing programs, and healthcare services.
* Monitor client progress and maintain regular follow\-up appointments.
* Advocate for clients with external providers, agencies, and systems of care.
* Maintain accurate and timely case notes, documentation, and data entry in accordance with agency standards.
* Ensure clients understand the organization’s behavior policies and support them in following the policies so that they may continue to access services.
* Develop and implement a schedule of groups, and other events that align with client needs and organizational goals in collaboration with internal and external entities.
* Develop strategies to increase veteran engagement and program participation to meet goals and outcomes of all funding sources.

Community Health \& Care Coordination


* Educate clients on health\-related topics including wellness, preventive care, mental health, harm reduction, and available community resources.
* Support coordination of medical and behavioral health appointments.
* Assist clients in navigating healthcare systems and accessing community\-based care.
* Collaborate with healthcare providers and multidisciplinary teams to ensure continuity of care.

Grants and Contracts:


* Adhere to program budgets set by the Program Manager or other leadership.
* Review grant and program deliverables with leadership to help the program implement goals, developing processes and procedures to meet grant deliverables.
* Work within the context of active MOUs with external partners and stay in compliance.
* Understand reporting requirements and ensure timely submission of program data and reports for various funders.
* Preparing for and ensuring success of all grant and contract audits.
* Responsible for timely reports and ad\-hoc presentations as requested by leadership.

Crisis Intervention \& De\-escalation:


* Respond appropriately to client crises using de\-escalation and conflict resolution techniques.
* Follow agency protocols regarding safety concerns, incident reporting, and emergency response procedures.
* Maintain professional boundaries while supporting clients through challenging situations.

Administrative \& Program Support:


* Maintain confidential and organized client records.
* Participate in team meetings, training, case conferences, and supervision.
* Assist with program operations, data collection, and reporting requirements.
Perform other duties as assigned.  
* 

**Supervisory Responsibilities (If Applicable)**

· Temporarily act as team lead in the absence of the Program Manager and Community Case Manager.  



**Desired Qualifications:**

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 1–2 years’ experience working with underserved or vulnerable populations is required.
* Fluency in English and ability to effectively read, write, and communicate in English with staff, clients, and external partners and stakeholders.
* A minimum of 1 year of experience in case management, outreach, behavioral health, homeless services, substance use disorders, or social services is required.
* Knowledge of community resources, healthcare systems, and social service programs (i.e. Medi\-Cal, SSI, CalFresh, VA) is required.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills are required.
* Ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds is required.

-----------


The Advanced Medical Support Assistant (AMSA) in the San Francisco VA Healthcare System Call Center serves as part of an interprofessional healthcare team. AMSA provides support across multiple ancillary and interprofessional clinics and determines the needs of the Veteran/caregiver. The AMSA plays an integral role in achieving first\-contact resolution through Veteran\-centered delivery of care.

Learn more about this agency

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional

Work involves specialized administrative judgment and the flexible use of a wide range of clinical flow processes relating to access to care across multiple clinics, specialties, and/or care in the community resources. Works collaboratively with VISN programs, services, and interprofessional coordinated care team members to provide access to care and meet the needs of Veterans via various available contact modalities to include but not limited to telephone calls, secure messaging, chat, text messaging and video. jobs.title: Project Manager, Configuration Management
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly\-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.



With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.



Astranis has raised over $1\.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

**Project Manager, Configuration Management**



We're looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented PLM Analyst I to help keep the product data and engineering\-change processes behind our spacecraft moving quickly and accurately. This is an excellent entry\-level opportunity for someone who enjoys structured technical work, thrives on solving operational puzzles, and wants a front\-row seat to how complex hardware is designed, released, built, and improved.



You'll work closely with our PLM team and partners across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality. Your core focus will be managing the intake, entry, routing, and quality review of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), helping ensure that every change to our hardware is documented, reviewed, traceable, and ready for execution.



By owning these essential day\-to\-day workflows, you'll help scale the systems and processes that enable Astranis to build satellites faster and more reliably.


**Role**


* Create, enter, maintain, and track Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and associated PLM records
* Review ECO submissions for completeness, accuracy, required documentation, and adherence to established naming, revision\-control, and release standards
* Coordinate ECO routing, approvals, and follow\-up across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and other cross\-functional teams
* Proactively identify stalled, incomplete, or inconsistent change requests and work with stakeholders to keep them moving
* Support the release and revision of parts, assemblies, drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and related engineering documentation
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and metrics for ECO throughput, backlog, cycle time, and data quality


**Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, manufacturing, information systems, or another related technical field—or equivalent relevant experience.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to perform high\-accuracy, process\-driven work.
* Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working with structured data, spreadsheets, and technical documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize effectively, and follow defined
* processes.
* A collaborative approach and comfort working with technical and operational stakeholders.
* Curiosity about how physical products are designed, documented, released, and built.


**Bonus**


* Professional experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, quality, or configuration\-management teams.
* Familiarity with product lifecycle management (PLM), enterprise resource planning (ERP), document\-control, ticketing, or workflow\-management systems.
* Exposure to engineering drawings, BOMs, part numbers, revisions, or change\-control processes.
* Interest in aerospace, satellites, or complex hardware development.

**U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required**
(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.
#### **Astranis SMS Terms of Service**



* **Recruiting Updates:** By opting in, you agree to receive SMS updates, interview coordination, and recruiting communications from Astranis Space Technologies Corp.


* **Opt\-Out:** You can cancel this service at any time by replying **STOP**. We will send one final text confirming your unsubscription.


* **Opt\-In Again:** To resume receiving messages, reply **START** or **YES**.


* **Support \& Rates:** For assistance, reply **HELP** or contact us at coordinators@astranis.com. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies; carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.


* **Privacy:** For details on how we protect your data, view our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: AV Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.



Flexdrive, Lyft's wholly\-owned fleet management subsidiary, is undergoing a transformational shift from traditional rideshare fleet operations to autonomous vehicle fleet ownership and operations. We are seeking an AV Program Manager to help drive the cross\-functional operating plan that will prepare Flexdrive to receive, staff, and operate AV fleets at scale domestically and abroad.



This role supports the operational backbone of Flexdrive's AV readiness initiative. You will maintain the program timeline, coordinate cross\-functional workstreams spanning infrastructure, people, fleet operations, treasury, legal, and finance, and help ensure that requirements are tracked, dependencies are surfaced, and deployment milestones are met. You will work closely with workstream leads across Operations, Strategy, Infrastructure, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and People.



If you thrive in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex multi\-workstream programs, and have a bias toward action, this role is for you.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


### **1\. Program Planning \& Execution**


* Maintain the program timeline for Flexdrive AV Operating Readiness, tracking deliverables and dependencies across workstreams: Strategic Planning, Infrastructure, Analytics, People, Fleet Operations, Treasury, Finance, and Legal.
* Maintain the program's RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), surfacing cross\-functional blockers with clear context for escalation.
* Support weekly leadership syncs and monthly deep\-dive reviews, including preparation, presentation and follow\-through.
* Translate upstream decisions (partner agreements, market selections, ) into operational requirements, updating the readiness roadmap accordingly.

### **2\. Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Serve as a connection point between workstream leads, helping ensure infrastructure timelines align with hiring plans, capital deployment schedules match construction milestones, and fleet operations readiness tracks to vehicle delivery dates.
* Act as the central hub across cross\-functional internal teams supporting the program; drive alignment on priorities and decisions, escalate issues with the right context, and be accountable for resolution
* Coordinate with People and Operations to help sequence hiring, training, and certification programs ahead of vehicle arrivals.
* Work with FP\&A and Treasury to track investment spend against the capital deployment schedule and flag variance early.

### **3\. Stakeholder Communication \& Reporting**


* Build and deliver clear status reporting to program leadership and workstream stakeholders.
* Ensure cross\-functional stakeholders stay aligned on expectations, deliverables, and timelines throughout the program.
* Maintain market readiness scorecards that provide visibility into each market's progress against deployment milestones.
* Create and maintain program documentation including decision logs, meeting notes, and workstream status trackers.

### **4\. Process Support \& Operational Excellence**


* Help design and implement the program management operating model for AV readiness
* Identify and build process improvements across workstreams, using data to help optimize timelines and resource allocation.
* Build repeatable playbooks for market readiness that scale

**Experience:**
---------------


* 5 years of experience in program management, business operations, or a similar cross\-functional role, ideally within high\-growth tech, fleet management, logistics, or infrastructure\-heavy environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate operational detail into clear updates for cross\-functional stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills, with experience tracking timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple workstreams, and adapting whatever program management tools or frameworks the situation calls for
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate effectively in a fast\-moving environment where priorities and processes continue to evolve
* Strong relationship\-building skills, with the ability to organize effective working groups and resolve conflicts around program processes and goals.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to identify risks, quantify trade\-offs, and recommend courses of action with imperfect information.
* **Preferred**
	+ Experience preparing materials for and presenting to senior leaders
	+ Experience with infrastructure buildout programs (depot construction, facility standup, real estate development).
	+ Background in capital intensive projects, fleet management, automotive, mobility, or autonomous vehicle operations.
	+ Experience managing programs that span domestic and international markets.
	+ Experience in a subsidiary or business unit operating within a larger corporate parent.

**Benefits:**
-------------


* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any oth
