jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence

This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead and contribute to impactful projects that help government clients modernize their Human Capital Management (HCM) and payroll systems. The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in management consulting, a passion for solving complex business challenges, and the ability to lead teams and drive results.

* Analyze business operations and develop actionable recommendations for improvement

* Support clients with analytical research to align policies, procedures, and business needs with configured functionality
* Apply Agile methodology to write user stories, plan and monitor development and deployment progress, and demonstrate delivered functionality
* Support testing and reconciliation from the functional / business process perspective
* Deliver high\-quality written reports, process documentation, and engaging client presentations
* Work closely with project managers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget
* Support proposal development, client relationship management, and business development efforts

* Current certification in one or more of the following: CBAP, CSM, PMI\-PBA, or PMP
* In\-depth knowledge of HR/Payroll processes
* Prior experience implementing payroll or HCM software, including system configuration and testing
* Prior experience using ALM software (JIRA, DevOps, ELM)
* Experience performing work in a structured Agile or Scrum environment
* Demonstrated ability to lead and coach within a matrixed environment
* Strong experience working with public sector clients
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and quantitative skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel)
* Self\-motivated, flexible, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively
* A consistent record of delivering high\-quality work under tight deadlines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on large projects (100k\+ employees, multi\-year implementations)
* Experience working with enterprise\-level government systems and public sector project lifecycles

Epicus Group is a professional project and construction management firm providing owner’s representative consulting services, including workplace strategy, capital program planning, and facilities management. Our work spans the Life Sciences, Energy, and Government sectors, where we deliver comprehensive management and advisory services. We serve as an unbiased advocate for our clients, providing leadership and strategic guidance to navigate complex real estate challenges while minimizing risk and maximizing outcomes.

As we continue to expand our portfolio of exciting projects in Northern California, we are seeking a passionate Project Manager to join our growing team and deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. The Project Manager will build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as the central point of contact for both internal stakeholders and external partners. You will lead efforts to streamline communication, drive strategic decision\-making, and optimize the performance of the client’s real estate assets. If you excel in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, possess a strategic mindset, and are passionate about delivering exceptional results while shaping the future of a growing business, we invite you to join Epicus Group.

**Your Role:** 

As a Project Manager, you will interface with Epicus clients and project teams through a successful process of strategic real estate planning, design, and construction of new buildings, tenant improvement buildouts, and facilities assignments. Some of the ways you will support our projects are:

* Serve as the primary liaison between clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and city officials, fostering strong partnerships and effective collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead procurement efforts for design, construction, peer reviews, and specialty consultant services, including drafting scopes, evaluating proposals, negotiating contracts, and authorizing contract execution and purchase orders.
* Take the lead in preparing and implementing the project execution plan, project kick\-off activities, meetings, presentations, and ongoing project communications to ensure alignment with client objectives and company goals.
* Manage the design and construction phases, including oversight of architectural and engineering drawings, bid documents, contractor coordination, and agency approvals to ensure program, budget, and schedule conformance.
* Provide high\-level construction administration and coordination, including oversight of meetings, progress reporting, RFIs, submittals, cost control, schedule management, FF\&E coordination, and contractor performance.
* Direct and continuously monitor project budgets and schedules using web\-based project controls; perform meaningful financial and schedule analysis and proactively identify and resolve potential risks, changes, or impacts.

* Experience in the Northern California market, having strong relationships with clients, design firms, general contractors, and stakeholders
* Knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes, and regulations, from programming, entitlement and design through construction and operations.
* Highly motivated, ambitious and demonstrated business acumen, with a track record of exceeding targets. Expert at building relationships and earning trust.
* Detail\-oriented and analytical, excellent communication skills, strong organization and time management skills,

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account\-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.



You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account\-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.



In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high\-performing whole.


**What You'll Own**


* **Account\-Based Marketing Orchestration:** Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest\-impact contributions this role makes to the business.
* **Marketing Technology Foundation:** Own the day\-to\-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.
* **Agentic AI Workflow Engineering:** Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.
* **Enrichment and Insights:** Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account\-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first\-party behavioral signals, third\-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow\-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.
* **System Documentation and Enablement:** Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self\-sufficient, building self\-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.
  


**Who You Are**



You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.



You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high\-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.



You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross\-functional relationships are central to this role.



You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.


**What We're Looking For**


*Required*

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------



Hawthorne Health is a leading community site network and home research visit solution provider, with 20\+ sites and more than 2,000 research experienced healthcare professionals across the U.S. Hawthorne leverages convenient, trusted, healthcare locations, identified patient data, and intelligent technology to accelerate patient access, improve retention, and reduce study costs. By embedding high\-quality research within local communities, Hawthorne makes clinical trials more accessible and convenient for patients. Our community\-based model shortens timelines and helps bring better treatments to market, faster.



### **About the Role**


The Clinical Trials Project Manager is an integral piece of Hawthorne Health’s business and is critical to achieving success in delivering a high\-quality experience for our clients, Health Research Outcomes Professionals (HEROs), and the larger patient population. This individual is responsible for the day\-to\-day operations of assigned clinical trials/programs (“projects”) as well as serving as a cross\-functional leader to ensure projects are executed successfully and in accordance with the company’s overall program goals, timeline, budget and quality expectations and are in compliance with the company’s procedures, FDA regulations, GCP, ICH requirements and any other applicable regulations. The ideal person to fit this role is highly organized, collaborative, communicates well, and has progressive clinical trial oversight experience.### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Lead clinical trial execution across the site network**, overseeing study start\-up, activation, and ongoing operational performance.
* **Assess protocol feasibility** and support study planning, including resource allocation, budget considerations, and recruitment strategy development.
* **Drive study start\-up timelines**, coordinating with internal teams (Regulatory, Contracts, Budget) to ensure efficient site activation.
* **Serve as the primary operational liaison for Sponsors and CROs**, providing regular updates on study progress, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* **Develop and manage project plans**, tracking milestones, timelines, enrollment targets, and overall study performance.
* **Monitor site metrics** including enrollment, data entry, and query resolution, implementing strategies to optimize study performance.
* **Coordinate monitoring visits, audits, and investigator meetings**, ensuring site readiness and proper study execution.
* **Support regulatory and compliance activities**, including essential document collection, IRB submissions, protocol amendments, and safety reporting.
* **Act as a central resource for site teams**, resolving operational and protocol\-related challenges and driving timely solutions.
### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related field preferred.
* 3\+ years of clinical research experience, including **at least 2 years in a Project Manager, Clinical Trial Manager (CTM), or Lead CRC role**.
* Experience working with a **clinical research network, CRO, or pharmaceutical/biotech sponsor** strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of **ICH\-GCP guidelines and regulatory requirements** governing clinical trials.
* Proficiency with **clinical trial systems**, including EDC platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm) and eTMF.
* Excellent **organizational and project management skills** with the ability to manage multiple complex studies and timelines.
* Strong **communication and stakeholder management skills**, with the ability to convey complex information to site staff, sponsors, and internal teams.
* Demonstrated **problem\-solving and critical thinking abilities** in a fast\-paced research environment.
* **PMP, CCRP, CCRA, or other project management/clinical research certifications** are a plus.

### **Additional Information**

* This remote role requires up to 30% travel


Final rate determined based on experience and qualifications.



**Join our team!**
------------------



Hawthorne Health is transforming the clinical trial landscape through an innovative site model that integrates research into community\-based settings like local pharmacies. By meeting patients where they already receive care, we are improving access, strengthening trust, and driving more inclusive and efficient trials.



We welcome the opportunity to connect with individuals interested in being part of this evolving model.

As the Strategy \& Operations Program Manager for Global Technical Enablement (GTE), you will serve as the operational right hand and proxy to the Head of GTE. This is not a general program\-management role; your mandate is to build the operating system that runs the organization and keep the business inspection\-ready at all times.


You will not have direct reports; instead, your influence and operational rigor will ensure that critical multi\-team programs move smoothly from ideation to delivery. You will sit with the Head, be in the room for the decisions, carry their proxy, and govern the organization's technological, financial, and strategic resources. Ultimately, you will own the living story of the business, the cadence, the data narrative, and the cross\-cutting initiatives that belong to no single team; ensuring leadership can speak to status, strategy, and risk at a moment's notice.


Wiz’s Global Technical Enablement (GTE) team is the end\-to\-end owner of technical product mastery. We build and execute role\-based onboarding, interactive learning journeys, and hands\-on lab environments that enable our technical field teams and customers to position, deploy, and optimize complex cloud solutions at scale. Operating across 8 time zones and 6 countries, we pride ourselves on dependability, radical collaboration, and continuous innovation.


To ensure the strategic value of this role is maintained, please note that it is explicitly:


* Not a layer between the Head and the four team leaders, their direct line is unchanged.
* Not the owner of team execution: Architecture, TLDD, Experiences, and TEDO run their own work.
* Not an Executive Assistant: no calendar, travel, or expense ownership.

**Responsibilities:**

* Drive the OKR Lifecycle: Partner with leadership to draft, cascade, and track OKRs, proactively mitigating schedule risks before they impact the business.
* Govern the Decision Log: Ensure that nothing agreed upon leaves the room without an owner and a date, and follow through so that initiatives don't stall or quietly die after kickoff.
* Build the Case (Tech Spend \& Forecasting): Lead financial forecasting, budget tracking, and business case development specifically for the organization’s enablement infrastructure (lab environments, software licensing, tool subscriptions, and vendor platforms).
* Vendor \& Platform Lifecycle: Oversee the end\-to\-end renewals of GTE platforms, manage vendor relationships, and optimize the operational tech stack.
* Access \& Tech Governance: Manage the integration, provisioning, and access logistics for the org's internal and external enablement platforms, ensuring seamless workflows and security compliance.
* Own the "Walking Deck": Maintain a continuously current narrative of the business (org, strategy, OKR status, metrics, risks, and wins) that is ready to present with zero prep.
* Turn Data into Narrative: Partner with analysts to convert central dashboards, learner throughput, and course CSAT into the actionable story leadership needs.
* Anticipate the Inspection: Prepare the Head

The flagship course is a 40\-hour Wastewater Class 3 Operator Training recognized by the Georgia Secretary of State, alongside a 24\-hour continuing education course and an industrial wastewater program. Slater Certified, LLC is the workforce development arm of Slater Infrastructure Group, LLC \- an Alpharetta, Georgia infrastructure services firm founded in 1997, working across operations and maintenance, construction engineering and inspection, and environmental services for public and private clients. The team is small and moves fast. **Position summary**

Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. We are hiring a Project Manager on a contract basis to be the bridge between sales and delivery. jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.
  
The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.
  
  

**Location:** Preferred Northeast or Southeast
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.

* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, internal and external consultants and subject matter experts, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members. Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Coordinates all deliverable documentation between all internal and external stakeholders. Facilitates and directs document reviews to assure proper documentation is delivered to the client. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates transition of projects to later phase project teams.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence, and people management skills. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.


**Physical Demands:**  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee. The employee will experience normal office conditions and be required to use office equipment such as computers, peripherals, etc.

Some travel by car and occasional airplane trips should be expected as much of our consulting work is conducted remotely with occasional in person meetings. **Position Summary**
--------------------


The BioWatch Project Manager (PM) oversees nationwide BioWatch laboratory staffing and operational support for the Department of Homeland Security’s Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office. This position serves as the contractor’s primary point of contact for DHS, ensuring high\-quality laboratory performance, staffing continuity, compliance with federal standards, and successful execution of mission\-critical biothreat detection operations. The PM leads distributed scientific teams and ensures BioWatch laboratories maintain 24/7 readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead and manage all contractor activities supporting BioWatch laboratory operations across multiple jurisdictions.
* Serve as the single point of contact for the DHS Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer’s Representative.
* Oversee daily performance, attendance, conduct, and quality compliance for all contractor lab personnel.
* Ensure staffing levels meet or exceed DHS requirements and coordinate timely recruitment, replacement, and onboarding.
* Support adherence to BioWatch standard operating procedures, quality assurance programs, and national security protocols.
* Coordinate with Technical Managers and Training Manager to resolve operational issues, implement corrective actions, and maintain training compliance.
* Provide monthly progress reports, annual performance updates, and regular briefings to DHS leadership.
* Ensure readiness for surge support, special events, and emergency deployments, including rapid mobilization of trained staff.
* Maintain professional communication with state and local Laboratory Directors, ensuring seamless partnership and operational continuity.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, molecular biology, or a closely related biological science.

* Strong leadership skills managing dispersed scientific teams and complex operations.

jobs.title: Business Operations / Marketing Coordinator - Part time
jobs.description:
**Business Operations / Marketing Coordinator**

Victory Programming LLC provides CMM programming, training, and support to manufacturers using Zeiss coordinate measuring machines. We're looking for an organized, proactive, detail\-oriented Business Operations / Marketing Coordinator to help us run and grow the business.

This role works directly with the CEO/owner and is meant to grow into a trusted, highly capable extension of the CEO — someone who takes ownership of business processes, spots problems, and solves them, not just completes assigned tasks.

Remote, but Minnesota preferred (Central MN or Twin Cities area) for occasional in\-person meetings. Part\-time, approximately 20 hours/week, flexible schedule, with potential to grow into full\-time.

**The Opportunity**

The CEO's highest\-value work is complex CMM programming, coaching customers, building training resources, and creating time\-saving tools. This role is meant to take on the day\-to\-day operations work so the CEO can focus there. Expect a mix of customer coordination, Zoho workflow improvements, prospect follow\-up, video editing, research, and finding better ways to handle recurring tasks.

**Responsibilities**

* **Business Operations \& Admin:** Manage calendars, scheduling, email, and phone communications; coordinate customer onboarding (NDAs, forms, POs, scheduling); handle business travel and file organization; follow up on invoices, quotes, and action items; coordinate freelancers/vendors; handle research and admin projects
* **Customer Communication \& Project Coordination:** Serve as a routine point of contact; communicate professionally by email/phone; judge when CEO involvement is needed; help manage projects start to finish
* **Marketing \& Business Development:** Run email marketing (Zoho Campaigns); research prospects and opportunities; manage YouTube channel (editing/publishing) and social media; recommend website improvements; develop tutorial content and a knowledge base
* **Technology \& Process Improvement:** Maintain/improve Zoho Creator and CRM systems; identify and automate inefficient processes; research new tools; support WordPress/Wix site upkeep
* **Financial \& Other Support:** Maintain financial records; help prep info for taxes; support AR and financial\-process automation; own problems through to completion; other duties as needed

**What We're Looking For**

*Character:* Truthful, humble, a good listener, self\-motivated, dependable, detail\-oriented but able to see the big picture, resourceful, comfortable admitting what they don't know, discreet with confidential information, committed to doing things right rather than just checking boxes. Character and ability to learn matter more than experience with any specific system.

*Organization \& Communication:* Strong organizational, time\-management, and communication skills; able to juggle priorities with minimal supervision; professional with customers and vendors; good judgment on what needs CEO attention.

*Technology:* Comfortable learning new tools; ideally some experience with Microsoft Office/Outlook/Teams, Zoom, Zoho Creator/CRM/Books/Campaigns, WordPress/Wix, YouTube Studio, AI tools like ChatGPT, and cloud file management. Zoho Creator experience is a plus but not required — we'll train the right person.

*Industry Experience:* Background in manufacturing, engineering, quality, metrology, CMMs, CAD, aerospace, or medical manufacturing is a plus but not required. You don't need to be a CMM expert.

**Level of Responsibility**

This role is designed to grow. The CEO will provide more direction early on; as you demonstrate judgment, reliability, and understanding of the business, you'll take on more decision\-making authority — eventually owning substantial parts of day\-to\-day operations and customer communication. We're looking for someone who brings solutions, not just problems.

**Schedule \& Compensation**

* \~20 hrs/week initially, flexible schedule, weekday business hours, no weekends required
* Remote; Minnesota preferred; occasional in\-person meetings in Central MN/Twin Cities
* Potential to grow into full\-time
* $30–$45/hour based on experience — strong Zoho Creator, ops, marketing, or automation experience qualifies toward the upper end
* No benefits at part\-time status; may be considered if the role becomes full\-time

**What Success Looks Like**

Routine operations run smoothly without constant direction; customer communications, projects, and follow\-ups stay on track; CRM data stays accurate; inefficiencies get identified and fixed; marketing runs consistently; problems come with solutions attached — freeing the CEO to focus on CMM programming, coaching, and building new tools.

**Why This Might Be a Good Fit**

A chance to learn how a specialized technical business runs, take on real responsibility, and shape the role as you grow into it.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.description:
QA Lead to own software quality across Cidi Labs products.


### **About Cidi Labs**


Cidi Labs is a small but mighty company with a track record of providing innovative plugins for the Canvas LMS that over 600 educational institutions are using to enhance their online courses. We pride ourselves on our customer\-first obsession and the huge amount of love our customers feel for our products and team. Our company culture is one of kindness, fun, hard work and flexibility \- a great combo if we say so ourselves. If you love to delight customers and you want to work with a team that is passionate about making a difference in education, check out our job openings!
### **Description**


**Quality Assurance Lead**
--------------------------

### **Overview**


We're looking for a QA Lead to own software quality across Cidi Labs products. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead the QA effort among our developers by setting testing standards, guiding how quality is built into each feature, and holding the bar for every release.


Success requires becoming a product expert. You'll need to understand our applications, customer workflows, and expected behavior well enough to spot gaps in requirements and validate releases with confidence.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own release quality and define the testing strategy and standards across all products.
* Partner with developers so new features ship with appropriate unit and integration tests, and identify and close coverage gaps.
* Maintain a small, reliable end\-to\-end smoke suite covering critical user workflows.
* Strengthen CI/CD quality gates and establish quality metrics.
* Perform exploratory and regression testing, and investigate defects using browser developer tools, network traffic, logs, and API responses.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes.
* Work with Product, Engineering, and Business Analysts to improve requirement clarity and testability.
* Mentor developers and interns on testing best practices, fostering shared ownership of quality.

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3\+ years of experience in software quality assurance or test automation for web applications.
* Strong understanding of unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing strategies.
* Experience implementing automated testing in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience validating REST APIs with tools such as Postman.
* Ability to lead through influence, with excellent communication and collaboration skills.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience with PHP, React, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks such as PHPUnit, Jest, Vitest, or Playwright.
* Experience with GitLab CI/CD and cloud\-hosted SaaS applications.
* Knowledge of WCAG and accessibility testing.
* Experience in educational technology, instructional design, or Canvas LMS, including Cidi Labs products.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Higher unit and integration test coverage across all products, backed by a lean E2E smoke suite.
* Fewer regressions and greater release confidence.
* Developers consistently owning quality for the features they build.

 **What You'll Love About Cidi Labs**

* Great Company Culture
* Room to Grow your Career
* Flexible Time Off Policy
* 401(k) with a generous company match
* Fully remote work
* Health Benefits

 **Work Environment**


This role is performed primarily at a computer in a home or remote office setting. Join our team and be part of a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions will make a meaningful impact on the success of our clients and the growth of our organization.

  


#### **Salary**


$75,000 \- $90,000 per year

**Location: Remote/Hybrid \- USA**

**Department Name: Finance Operations \- AP**


**Job Type: Full Time, Non\-Exempt**


**Compensation: Starting at $20/hour** (Actual compensation is commensurate with job related knowledge, skills, experience, etc.)


**Position Summary**



The AP Operations Analyst is responsible for resolving invoice exceptions, payment discrepancies, and operational issues that impact the timely processing and payment of vendor invoices. Reporting to the Sr. Manager of AP Operations, this role serves as a key liaison between vendors, operations teams, sourcing, and finance partners to ensure accurate invoice processing, healthy vendor relationships, and uninterrupted service delivery for Rubicon customers.

  



The AP Operations Analyst manages invoice and work order backlogs, investigates payment and data discrepancies, supports AP aging management, and identifies root causes that impact payment processing. This position plays a critical role in maintaining operational continuity, improving process efficiency, supporting auto\-vouchering initiatives, and ensuring vendors are paid accurately and on time.

  


**Essential Duties \& Key Responsibilities**


* Manage invoice exceptions, work order backlogs, and unresolved payment issues for assigned customers and vendors.


* Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, short\-payments, credits, duplicate invoices, and past\-due balances.


* Partner with vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure invoice accuracy, compliance, and timely processing.


* Match invoices to appropriate work orders and supporting documentation to facilitate prompt payment.


* Monitor AP aging and proactively resolve issues to maintain account health and support uninterrupted vendor service.


* Investigate service interruptions and execute corrective actions to restore service and prevent recurrence.


* Identify, document, and escalate root causes of payment delays, invoice exceptions, and data discrepancies.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

  

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long\-term growth.


Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results\-driven approach.


Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100\+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.


At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.


If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long\-term development, we’d like to meet you!

  

API is seeking a seasoned professional to join our company in the role of Account Manager. This position may be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States or Canada, or in a hybrid capacity based out of our headquarters in Melville, New York. The Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for our clients and is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our Airline, Cruise Line, and Hotel partners. This role actively manages existing client relationships while ensuring exceptional service delivery and supporting the best interests of both our clients and API at all times. The ideal candidate is a proactive communicator, relationship\-builder, and strategic partner who is committed to delivering outstanding client experiences and driving long\-term success.  

  

**Essential Functions**  

  

**Sourcing**

* Oversee the direction of existing API accounts with the goal of maximizing prevailing relationships to expand market/wallet share versus preassigned revenue quota. This will include working closely with Research \& Sourcing team to provide all details of a destination to ensure a seamless approach to sourcing the destination.
* Assist with the sourcing of destinations by initiating the RFP process and being sensitive to supplier relationships.
* Total responsibility for ensuring the RFP results are documented in the customer destination presentation in an accurate, detailed oriented manner and the presentation meets the needs of the client, demonstrates a level of savings and meets the revenue goals of API.
* Strategic planning and organizing in order to maximize API revenue, as well as client savings goals; including but not limited to sourcing timelines for expiring contracts and contract renewal.


**Site Inspections**

* Conduct hotel site inspections domestically and internationally when required with customers ensuring each property meets client criteria.

**Contracting**

* Execute hotel contract negotiations on behalf of the Airline, contract renewals, and addendums. Keen ability to negotiate mutually beneficial contract terms and conditions.
* Monitor market conditions in each serviced destination to ensure the best rates, amenities and contract terms are maintained throughout the hotel contract.
* Conduct risk management for each destination the client services to proactively manage any potential risks to the contract based on changes to that hotel or market and negotiate terms that will positively impact our client.
* Proactively pursue and maintain, at all times, the best hotel relationships where the client has contracted.


**Day to Day Account Management**

* Work closely with the other members of the sales team to ensure client needs are met at all times and share leads that are uncovered by your communication with both the hotels and the airlines.


**CrewCare**

* Manage crew member feedback via our online portal for all assigned accounts ensuring any complaints are addressed in a timely fashion accordingly with our hotel partners and documented.
* Add new hotels to the system and ensure all information is accurate. Delete inactive hotels.


**Hotel Express**

* Ensure negotiated rates for Crew, Business and Leisure Travel and loaded and maintained properly on Hotel Express for clients.

**ACES**

* Verify all hotel contract information is loaded properly into ACES for OPS and for Accounting.
* Review ACES schedules monthly to ensure hotels are downloading their schedules. Assist OPS department with follow up with the hotels about the schedules.
* Verify client back up list is accurate and loaded into ACES for OPS.


**CRM**

* Ensure all revenue opportunities are in the CRM with accurate business start dates.
* Ensure all hotel/airline and API commission contracts are loaded, executed and attached to the CRM.
* Maintain all flight information
* Fully understand the client’s business and ensure all deliverables are being met for a successful relationship
* Strive to create increased value for the client by providing new points of view and recommendations that are align with desired business goals
* Work closely with the Business Development team to ensure a smooth client transition from contract signing to implementation
* Independently lead and make decisions that properly balance the needs of the client and API
* Manage all client communications ranging from weekly performance meetings to business reviews
* Own internal communications to the cross functional team on client performance, strategies and needs
* Become knowledgeable in all API technology platforms to ensure clients are align with appropriate software solution

 **Competencies**

* Problem Solving/Analysis
* Building Relationships
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Thinking
* Results Driven
* Negotiation
* Leadership
* Customer Focus
* Managing Processes

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C\-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

  

End users enjoy a seamless, zero\-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all\-in\-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

  

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

  

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and \[solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry\-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

### **The Role**


We’re seeking a Customer Success Manager to join the Customer Success team at Order.co and own the post\-sale \& post\-implementation experience for a growing portfolio of customers. This role is critical to ensuring customers realize ongoing value from the platform, deepen adoption over time, and view Order.co as a strategic partner in their purchasing and payments operations.


Reporting to Customer Success leadership, the Customer Success Manager will manage the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption through retention and expansion, serving as a trusted advisor to Operations and Finance stakeholders across small, mid\-market, and complex organizations. This role blends relationship management, consulting, and revenue ownership, with a strong emphasis on proactive engagement, churn mitigation, and net revenue retention.


The ideal candidate is highly consultative, commercially minded, and energized by helping customers achieve tangible business outcomes. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Operations, and Support teams to surface insights, resolve risks early, and continuously improve the customer experience. Above all, you’ll play a key role in driving long\-term customer loyalty, growth, and advocacy as Order.co continues to scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the main point of contact for your assigned accounts, owning the full post\-sale customer journey and building strong relationships with Operations and Finance professionals at small, medium, and large, complex organizations
* Retain and grow a rapidly expanding book of business
* Serve as the expert and go\-to consultant for your accounts on purchasing and payments best practices
* Dig deep to understand clients’ business goals and educate them how to leverage their Order subscription to meet these goals
* Proactively increase our share of wallet with clients; meet aggressive revenue targets while simultaneously mitigating churn and building brand champions (NRR is the name of the game)
* Collaborate with our Operations \& Product team to translate customer feedback into improvements across our platform
* Monitor your account’s Support ticket volume and escalate risk proactively
* Work closely with Management to understand analytical trends for your Clients and areas of strategic opportunity

 **Qualifications**  

About you:* You have 2\+ years in an Account Management or Customer Success role, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment
* You have consistently met and/or exceeded revenue and/or retention targets
* You have experience managing client data within a CRM, and are familiar with highly consultative, short sales cycles.
* You are exceptionally skilled at building strong business relationships. You can work equally well with end users and C\-level decision\-makers.
* You are action\-oriented, results driven, and able to work in a team environment
* You are able to prioritize autonomously and ask for advice or help when necessary
* You are an excellent and collaborative communicator across both written and verbal mediums
* You are a self\-aware, team\-focused asset who can provide insight into process optimization

**Additional Information**


What you’ll receive:

* A competitive compensation package including base and uncapped variable components
* The opportunity to grow quickly within the GTM organization
* Employer\-sponsored 401(k)
* A deep knowledge and understanding of selling a SaaS B2B product in the purchasing and payment space
* The opportunity to grow and perform in a fast\-paced environment alongside a stellar team
* Flexible time off and remote work policies
* Robust medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits
* Generous leave policies and support for new and current parents

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Rocket Clicks**

  

At Rocket Clicks, we help Family Law Firms grow through focused, performance\-driven digital marketing.

  

We are not a generalist agency. We are building the definitive growth partner for family law firms by combining deep marketing expertise, real law firm operating experience, and a disciplined approach to execution.


Our team thrives on solving hard problems, improving client performance, and building trusted long\-term relationships. We care about results, and we also care about how the work gets done.

  

Our culture is rooted in six core values:

* **Proactive** – We anticipate opportunities and act before problems arise.
* **Disciplined** – We remain focused and committed to excellence.
* **Candid** – We communicate clearly and directly.
* **Empathetic** – We understand and respect the perspectives of others.
* **Accountable** – We take ownership of results, good or bad.
* **Results\-Oriented** – We focus on outcomes, not busyness.


If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home at Rocket Clicks!

 **POSITION SUMMARY**

  

As an **Account Manager** at Rocket Clicks, you will own the relationship with a portfolio of family law firms at the owner and managing partner level. You will lead the strategic conversation, build and maintain the plan each firm is working from, and connect their business objectives to the work our marketing team delivers. Project managers handle delivery and specialists execute the channels, which leaves you free to stay in the conversation that matters most to the client.


We are looking for an experienced account leader with genuine commercial instincts. Someone comfortable discussing revenue, pricing, and capacity with a business owner, and confident enough to challenge a plan that does not hold up under scrutiny. Providing that perspective is the substance of this role.


The position is scoped to a single practice area for a reason. Working across a dozen family law firms at once, you will begin to recognize the same intake breakdowns, the same gaps between consultation and signed fee, and the same capacity ceilings surfacing again and again. That accumulated pattern recognition is what gives your recommendations weight in the room.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own the relationship with a portfolio of family law firms, serving as the primary strategic contact for owners and managing partners.
* Lead alignment calls and quarterly business reviews with decision makers, establishing clear agreement on goals, roles, timeline, and budget for the quarter ahead.
* Build and maintain a strategic roadmap for each client, revisiting it quarterly so the plan reflects where the firm is now rather than where it was when the engagement began.
* Track performance across the full client acquisition path, from initial lead through qualified lead, consultation, signed client, and funded agreement.
* Extend the conversation beyond marketing into pricing, intake, operations, capacity, and hiring, where the real constraints on a firm's growth usually sit.
* Identify growth opportunities and early signals of churn, raising both internally well before they surface with the client.
* Review and approve every client\-facing deliverable, making sure the work reflects the firm's goals and the context you hold on the relationship.
* Maintain a consistent communication rhythm of a weekly written update, a monthly pacing call, and a quarterly business review with firm leadership.
* Partner with project managers and channel specialists, giving them the business context they need to do their work well
* Manage your portfolio as a whole, making deliberate decisions about where your time produces the most value across the book.

 **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* 5\+ years in account leadership, consulting, or professional services, preferably in an agency or advisory environment.
* Significant experience owning senior client relationships, with a track record of working directly with business owners and executive decision makers.
* Commercial fluency across revenue, pricing, margin, and expansion, and the comfort to discuss all of it candidly with a client.
* Demonstrated ability to build plans that connect agency work to business outcomes, with defined timelines and milestones attached.
* Strong facilitation skills and the judgment to guide a client toward a decision rather than waiting to be handed one
* The ability to raise a difficult subject, whether an unrealistic goal or a number the client cannot produce, without damaging the relationship.
* Experience recognizing early signals of client dissatisfaction and acting on them before they escalate.
* Business experience outside of marketing, whether client\-side, in a general management or P\&L role, or as an owner.
* Genuine curiosity about how professional services firms operate: how they price, staff, sell, and scale.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience managing and developing people.
* A background in or adjacent to the legal industry.
* Familiarity with CRM data and intake operations.

 **BENEFITS:*** Unlimited PTO \& Sick Leave
* Medical Insurance (including FSA \& HSA Options)
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* 401(k) (with a company match)
* Life Insurance
* Long\-term Disability
* Short\-term Disability

 **Schedule:** Monday to Friday 8\-5 CST**Work Location:** Remote\-US **The pay range for this role is:**  

80,000 \- 100,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

As the CS Enablement Program Manager, you'll be the business owner of the systems that make both our human agents and AI agents effective, starting with the quality and integrity of the knowledge they rely on. As a highly autonomous, high\-judgment IC, you'll build and continuously improve the knowledge base, SOPs, training, and AI\-powered workflows that underpin Customer Support across Babylist and Babylist Health. You'll bring deep operational rigor and a strong understanding of how AI is changing customer support—using the technology in your own work while designing systems that make it more effective across the organization. This is a greenfield opportunity to build the CS Enablement function at a tech\-first consumer company: identifying where knowledge, policies, and workflows break down, and partnering across CS, BizOps Tech, Product, and Analytics to build a support system that gets smarter and more reliable as we scale.


**Who You Are**


* **Deep expertise in Support Operations, Enablement, or Knowledge Management**: you've owned documentation, workflows, and operational strategy in high\-volume environments.
* **Can build and manage a knowledge base from scratch** (Zendesk, Gladly, Help Scout, Notion, Guru, or similar), organizing content and maintaining accuracy at scale so both humans and AI systems can use it effectively.
* **Can design for a hybrid AI\-agent and human\-agent support organization**: structuring content for AI consumption, writing effective prompts, evaluating output quality, and calling the line between what's automated and what stays human\-owned.
* **Can write clear, usable SOPs** for complex, multi\-step, or edge\-case scenarios, and know when to automate them instead.
* **Can build and deliver training that actually changes how people work**: onboarding, process rollouts, tool adoption, AI workflow enablement.
* **Strong analytical instincts**: you can read support data (ticket trends, contact drivers, resolution times) and turn it into decisions about what to fix, automate, or rebuild.
* **Comfortable being the first person to do this job.** This space doesn't have an established playbook in customer support yet, you'll be creating it.
* **Effective cross\-functional partner** who can work with BizOps, Product, Analytics, and engineering\-adjacent teams to drive real change, not just executing within your own lane.
* **Demonstrated track record of using AI to do your own work better**. At Babylist every team uses AI daily. You're already using it daily to move faster and improve your output, and have real opinions about when it works and when it doesn't.


**How You Will Make An Impact**


* Build the CS Enablement program from the ground up: create the systems that keep agents (human and AI) current on knowledge base, training, and copilot content as product changes accelerate.
* Move support operations from AI\-assisted to AI\-native: rebuild workflows, documentation, and training so AI is the default operating model.
* Build and maintain the knowledge base that serves as the source of truth for both AI systems and human agents, structured for AI consumption and kept accurate as products and policies evolve.
* Close existing content gaps and continuously identify how to reduce unnecessary escalations and drive meaningful improvement in chatbot coverage and resolution rate.
* Lead the implementation of an AI copilot and bring usage to 90%\+ of agent interactions by making the copilot genuinely useful (better source material, better prompt design).
* Build agent confidence through scalable training that teaches people when to trust AI, when to override it, and how to give feedback that improves it.
* Create SOPs for complex scenarios so cases get handled consistently, audit and streamline fragmented workflows, and design new processes with AI built in from the start.
* Partner with the CS Analyst to identify top contact drivers and documentation gaps, then act on them.
* Establish feedback loops with frontline agents so the system keeps improving instead of just when someone notices a problem.


**Why This Role**


* **You'd be defining a role that doesn't have a template yet.** "AI\-native CS enablement" isn't an established discipline in customer support. You won't be applying someone else's playbook, you'll be writing it.
* **The foundation is still forming, and that's the opportunity.** Most of the knowledge base, SOPs, and AI workflows don't exist yet, so the systems you build become how the org operates for years.
* **You'll have real influence on the roadmap, not just execution against it.** You're setting the agenda with BizOps Tech, Product, and Analytics on what gets fixed, automated, and rebuilt next.
* **Your success is directly visible in the numbers that matter to the business**: chatbot deflection, copilot adoption, CSAT. This isn't a support role in the background, it's core to how CS scales.


**About Compensation**



We use a market\-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:


**$140,000 to $170,000**



Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.


**Who We Are**



Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go\-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI\-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025\. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.

**With the nation’s largest home infusion provider, there is no limit to the growth of your career.**


 Option Care Health, Inc. is the largest independent home and alternate site infusion services provider in the United States. With over 8,000 team members including 5,000 clinicians, we work compassionately to elevate standards of care for patients with acute and chronic conditions in all 50 states. Through our clinical leadership, expertise and national scale, Option Care Health is re\-imagining the infusion care experience for patients, customers and team members.


Join a company that is taking action to develop an inclusive, respectful, engaging and rewarding culture for all team members. Responsible for monitoring, trending, and analyzing quality metrics, identifying risks, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Evaluates and recommends process improvements to enhance the quality, consistency, compliance, and safety of compounded sterile preparations (CSPs).
  

Collaborates with appropriate stakeholders to ensure organization adherence to current regulations, industry standards, and best practices for sterile compounding. * In conjunction with management builds and maintains relationships with vendors. Provides support when intervention is required with vendors to support field cleanroom quality.
* Assist in the development of action plans for improvement based on Board of Pharmacy or other agency inspections, accreditation findings or internal quality indicators, recommendation and guidelines.

new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT INSOMNIA:**



Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then\-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery \+ delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet\-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!

  


Insomnia Cookies is actively hiring for a full\-time hourly Store Manager in Training (MIT) at our Dallas \- Victory Park store and we are seeking hospitality focused individuals looking to join our industry leading, rapidly growing, nationally recognized company!

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



At Insomnia Cookies, warm is more than how we serve our cookies—it’s how we show up for our guests, our teams, and each other.



As an Assistant Bakery Operations Manager (ABOM), you’ll help bring that to life every day by working side\-by\-side with your Bakery Operations Manager to build an energized, well\-trained team, create unforgettable guest experiences, and keep the bakery running at its best. You’ll coach and develop people, jump in wherever you’re needed, and take real ownership of the details that make a great bakery great—from staffing and inventory to quality, cleanliness, and execution. And when the BOM isn’t there, you’ll be ready to step up and lead.



This role is built for someone who wants more than an assistant manager job: it’s an opportunity to learn the business, grow as a leader, and develop the skills and confidence to one day run an Insomnia bakery of your own.


**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**



As a key member of the bakery leadership team, you will:


* Partner with your BOM to lead day\-to\-day bakery operations and deliver an exceptional guest experience.
* Lead the bakery independently when the BOM is away, keeping the team focused and operations running smoothly.
* Coach, motivate, and develop Shift Leaders and Cookie Crew members through real\-time feedback, recognition, and support.
* Support recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training to build a strong, fully staffed team.
* Help create schedules and manage labor to meet the needs of the bakery and the business.
* Support ordering, inventory management, product rotation, and shrink control.
* Maintain high standards for product quality, food safety, cleanliness, speed of service, and overall bakery execution.
* Complete required operational and administrative tasks accurately and on time.
* Identify opportunities to improve bakery performance and partner with your BOM and Area leadership to put solutions into action.
* Help create a culture where team members know what’s expected, feel supported, and are accountable for delivering their best.
* Jump in wherever needed—from serving guests and baking cookies to supporting the team during our busiest hours.


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**


* 1\+ year of leadership experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality, or another customer\-focused environment.
* Experience coaching, motivating, and developing hourly team members.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* A hands\-on leadership style and willingness to jump into any bakery role when needed.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple operational priorities.
* Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences and building great teams.
* Must be 18 years of age or older.
* Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.


**Physical Requirements**



This position regularly requires the ability to:


* Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
* Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
* Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
* Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
* Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point\-of\-sale system.
* Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
* Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
* Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
* Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast\-paced environment.


**Work Environment**



This position works in a fast\-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late\-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.


**Schedule Expectations**



Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**



Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Global Response Operations (GRO) is Meta's frontline defense against threats to platform integrity, user safety, regulatory compliance, and advertiser support. The Response teams solve essential escalations, remediate the most critical issues, and respond to urgent risks and incidents. We respond when the stakes are highest: high\-priority escalations that demand speed, precision, coordination, and judgement. We work closely with our partners to fix gaps in our platforms. Our mandate is to manage complex and novel situations that require special care across Meta's Family of Apps, all surfaces and domains, all issue types and all user groups. We are transitioning to an agentic operating model where AI handles routine work and human experts focus on the cases, decisions, and system improvements that require judgment, creativity, and domain depth.You will own Meta's most complex, sensitive, and time\-critical escalations, where AI reaches its limits and expert human judgment determines the outcome. Working across all Meta surfaces, products, and issue types, you'll investigate and resolve high\-stakes situations spanning civic concerns, entertainment events, advertiser integrity, regulatory risk, and AI product failures. You'll serve as a domain expert and workflow contributor by designing how humans and AI work together, critically evaluating AI outputs, encoding your expertise into systems that scale, and supporting others to do the same. You'll lead or contribute to pods that drive measurable operational improvement. This role is for people who thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly to shifting priorities, and see AI as a force multiplier for better outcomes.This role requires review of content, issues and matters that can be offensive or disturbing, including but not limited to graphic violence, self\-harm, hate speech, abuse, and sexually explicit material. Meta provides resources and support for employees who work with sensitive content. This role will require regular scheduled weekend and holiday on\-call work, and some non\-scheduled crisis intervention.

* Drive Meta's highest\-priority escalations to resolution: from initial triage through investigation, cross\-functional coordination, and final resolution, ensuring time\-sensitive cases are mitigated within SLA and with minimal business or reputational impact

* Coordinate across Policy, Legal, Engineering, Sales, Communications, Leadership, and other XFN: drive aligned response strategies on cases carrying reputational, legal, or business risk, translating complexity into clear decisions and accountable next steps
* Synthesize and deliver executive\-level communications: leverage AI to ensure accurate, actionable situational awareness reaches leadership and partners when it matters
* Exercise judgment on unprecedented situations: make high\-stakes calls and set precedent for continuous improvement
* Work on\-call shifts within a global team: maintain 24/7 readiness and operate effectively across time zones, delivering consistent quality and decision\-making during high\-priority escalations
* \*\*Human \+ AI Orchestration\*\*\*
* Contribute to workflow performance in your domain: support end\-to\-end quality across HITL and HOTL deployments, identifying when intervention is needed and flagging issues that affect automated outputs
* Translate expert human judgment into encodable logic: convert tacit domain knowledge (policy interpretation, contextual reasoning, edge case intuition) into explicit rules, prompts, and decision frameworks that AI systems can execute
* Lead or contribute to sprints and pods that transform operations: drive measurable improvements in efficiency, effectiveness, and performance outcomes
* Design and iterate on AI\-assisted workflows (prompts, decision trees, runbooks, automations): increase team throughput, measured by reduced handling time, enhanced outcomes, or eliminated manual steps for recurring case patterns
* Support peer development on judgment, AI tool mastery, and escalation calibration: share expertise through case reviews and real\-time modeling, contributing to the team's collective capability
* Conduct case quality reviews: identify patterns in errors and AI failures
* implement corrections that raise the bar for the team
* \*\*AI Judging and Design\*\*\*
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated assessments, investigation outputs, and recommended actions: correct and document failure patterns, feeding structured improvements back into the system so accuracy improves over time
* Identify when regulatory, policy, or operational context changes require capability updates: proactively flag when existing automation rules, prompts, or decision logic have become stale due to external shifts, ensuring systems reflect current reality
* Provide structured feedback on AI launches: deliver actionable recommendations for improvement based on operational experience
* Design escalation logic, runbooks, and decision trees for AI systems: define how AI handles edge cases and when it routes to humans
* Create and maintain AI prompts, playbooks, and evaluation rubrics: build the tooling layer that governs AI performance in your domain
* Test and validate new AI capabilities before deployment: ensure quality and reliability before workflows go live
* Design AI skills and capabilities to check and copilot human work: build manual and human\-in\-the\-loop quality mechanisms into operational processes
* \*\*Domain expertise \& signal generation\*\*\*

People\& Communities \| Cisco
